# Payments API

Vault Payments API is RESTful. It uses predictable and resource-oriented URLs with standard HTTP methods and status codes. Responses are in JSON format.

## [](#downloading_the_openapi_definition_file "Copy link to heading")Downloading the OpenAPI definition file

The Vault Payments API in OpenAPI 3.0 can be downloaded from here:

Download download

The specification includes Thought Machine-specific extensions that are not standard to OpenAPI. The generation method of the specification and resulting naming, paths and schemas are subject to change. For more information about the OpenAPI specification see the [OpenAPI specification](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.0.3).

## [](#3ds "Copy link to heading")3DS

### [](#threedsrecord "Copy link to heading")ThreeDSRecord

#### [](#available_methods "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cards_three_ds_ListThreeDSRecordsResponse_ListThreeDSRecords) Lists and filters 3DS Records.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_cards_three_ds_ThreeDSRecord_UpdateThreeDSRecord) Updates the specified 3DS record with the updated 3DS resource.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cards_three_ds_BatchGetThreeDSRecordsResponse_BatchGetThreeDSRecords) Retrieves one or more 3DS Records by their ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_three_ds_ListThreeDSRecordsResponse_ListThreeDSRecords "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters 3DS Records. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.3ds\_records:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/cards/3ds-records

##### [](#request "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

Number of 3DS Records to return per page.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Specifies which page of Card Orders to return.

 |
| 

**card\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Card IDs to filter results by.  
  
Max length: 100 characters.

 |

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_three_ds_ThreeDSRecord_UpdateThreeDSRecord "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates the specified 3DS record with the updated 3DS resource. Fields allowed for update are oob\_status and metadata.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.3ds\_records:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/cards/3ds-records/{three\_ds\_record.id}

##### [](#request_2 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
three\_ds\_record.  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the 3DS Record.

 |

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

Unique UUID identifying the request, used for idempotency.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

**three\_ds\_record**  
  
object

 | 

The 3DS Record resource with update applied. Required.

 |
| 

three\_ds\_record.  
**oob\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the OOB authentication. This field is only relevant for records with authentication channel OOB.  
  
**Enum values**  
**THREE\_DS\_RECORD\_OOB\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The OOB authentication status is uknown.  
**THREE\_DS\_RECORD\_OOB\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
The OOB status is pending.  
**THREE\_DS\_RECORD\_OOB\_STATUS\_APPROVED:**  
The OOB status is approved.  
**THREE\_DS\_RECORD\_OOB\_STATUS\_DECLINED:**  
The OOB status is declined.  
**THREE\_DS\_RECORD\_OOB\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The OOB status is cancelled.  
**THREE\_DS\_RECORD\_OOB\_STATUS\_EXPIRED:**  
The OOB status is expired.  
  
**Default**  
**THREE\_DS\_RECORD\_OOB\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

three\_ds\_record.  
**metadata**  
  
object

 | 

Metadata related to the resource.

 |
| 

**update\_mask**  
  
object

 | 

The field mask used to indicate which fields of the 3DS record are to be updated. The allowed fields are: oob\_status and metadata.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

update\_mask.  
**paths\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The set of field mask paths.

 |

## [](#account_ranges "Copy link to heading")Account Ranges

### [](#accountrange "Copy link to heading")AccountRange

#### [](#available_methods_2 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_ListAccountRangesResponse_ListAccountRanges) List AccountRanges.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_AccountRange_CreateAccountRange) Creates a new Account Range.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_BatchGetAccountRangesResponse_BatchGetAccountRanges) Retrieves the AccountRanges with the specified IDs.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_ListAccountRangesResponse_ListAccountRanges "Copy link to heading")List

List AccountRanges.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.account\_ranges:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/cards/account-ranges

##### [](#request_4 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

Number of AccountRanges to return per page.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Specifies which page of AccountRanges to return.

 |
| 

**encryption\_request**  
  
object

 | 

The encryption details.

 |
| 

encryption\_request.  
**client\_public\_key**  
  
string

 | 

The ephemeral client public key used to derive the shared encryption key. Hex-encoded ASN.1 DER format 256-bit ECC public key.

 |
| 

encryption\_request.  
**signature**  
  
string

 | 

The client SHA-256 signature on the client public key. Hex-encoded.

 |

Success Errors

|

array \[object\]

 | 

The result set for the request.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

UUID that uniquely identifies the AccountRange. If not set on creation, a random UUID will be generated.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

Status of the AccountRange resource. On creation this is set to ACTIVE.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate account range status during creation which disallows Card issuance.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
Account range status which disallows Card issuance.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
Account range status which allows Cards to be issued.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
Account range status that is terminal, which disallows Card issuance.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**scheme\_product\_code**  
  
string

 | 

Code representing the scheme product to which this AccountRange belongs.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].

long

 | 

The length of PANs in this AccountRange. Required on creation.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**range\_from**  
  
string

 | 

The encrypted lower bound of the spanned range. The cleartext value must be 11 digits long, it must span one of the associated BINs and it must not clash with any existing range. Required on creation.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**range\_to**  
  
string

 | 

The encrypted upper bound of the spanned range. The cleartext value must be 11 digits long, it must span one of the associated BINs and it must not clash with any existing range. Required on creation.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**count**  
  
string (uint64)

 | 

The number of PANs that have already been allocated in this AccountRange.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**capacity**  
  
string (uint64)

 | 

The maximum number of PANs that should be assigned to this AccountRange. This is an indicative limit value, enforced on a best-effort basis. If not set, 30% of the PAN space will be allocated. The PAN check digits are incorporated within this number. For example, the max number of 16 digit PANs prefixed by a single 11 digit number would be 10000, not 100000.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**is\_full**  
  
boolean

 | 

Whether any more PANs can be allocated within this AccountRange.

 |

dateTime

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_AccountRange_CreateAccountRange "Copy link to heading")Create

Creates a new Account Range. Must be called after Cards.InitiateEncryptedSession.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.account\_ranges:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/cards/account-ranges

##### [](#request_5 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

Unique UUID identifying the request, used for idempotency.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

**account\_range**  
  
object

 | 

The AccountRange resource to be created.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

account\_range.  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

UUID that uniquely identifies the AccountRange. If not set on creation, a random UUID will be generated.

 |
| 

account\_range.  
**scheme\_product\_code**  
  
string

 | 

Code representing the scheme product to which this AccountRange belongs.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

account\_range.  
**pan\_length**  
  
long

 | 

The length of PANs in this AccountRange. Required on creation.

 |
| 

account\_range.  
**range\_from**  
  
string

 | 

The encrypted lower bound of the spanned range. The cleartext value must be 11 digits long, it must span one of the associated BINs and it must not clash with any existing range. Required on creation.

 |
| 

account\_range.  
**range\_to**  
  
string

 | 

The encrypted upper bound of the spanned range. The cleartext value must be 11 digits long, it must span one of the associated BINs and it must not clash with any existing range. Required on creation.

 |
| 

account\_range.  
**capacity**  
  
string (uint64)

 | 

The maximum number of PANs that should be assigned to this AccountRange. This is an indicative limit value, enforced on a best-effort basis. If not set, 30% of the PAN space will be allocated. The PAN check digits are incorporated within this number. For example, the max number of 16 digit PANs prefixed by a single 11 digit number would be 10000, not 100000.

 |
| 

**shared\_key\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the shared key from an initiate session encryption response.

 |

## [](#aggregations "Copy link to heading")Aggregations

### [](#payment "Copy link to heading")Payment

#### [](#available_methods_3 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Aggregate](#_payments_v1_aggregations_AggregateResponse_AggregatePayments) Computes aggregated metrics from the Payments processed through Vault Payments.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_aggregations_AggregateResponse_AggregatePayments "Copy link to heading")Aggregate

Computes aggregated metrics from the Payments processed through Vault Payments. Details about the different features can be found on the [Aggregations](/vault-payments/latest/EN/api/aggregations) page.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.aggregations.payments:read

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/aggregations/payments

##### [](#request_7 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**filter\_query**  
  
string

 | 

A search query written in the Vault Payments Search Query Language. Documentation for the language can be found on the "Search Query Language" page. Optional. If provided, the resources included when calculating the aggregations will be restricted to the search results for the query provided.

 |
| 

**aggregations**  
  
map \[string: object\]

 | 

A map of aggregation names to aggregation request definitions.  
  
Required.  
Min count: 1.  
Max count: 100.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
**filter\_query**  
  
string

 | 

A filter query written in the Vault Payments Search Query Language. If provided, the resources included when calculating the aggregation will be restricted to the search results for the query provided.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
**grouping\_levels\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

A list of grouping levels which must be applied to the resources included in the aggregation. The provided field or rate aggregation will be applied to the buckets of resources returned by each level.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
**filter\_buckets\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

Filter buckets are used to define custom buckets in which resources should be grouped. For each filter query provided, a bucket of resources with will be returned with the provided ID. One of filter\_buckets, field\_buckets or time\_interval\_buckets must be set for a single aggregation.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
filter\_buckets\[\].  
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the returned bucket. Required.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
filter\_buckets\[\].  
**query**  
  
string

 | 

The Search Query Language query that will be used to filter the resources to aggregate into this bucket. If empty, no filter is applied and all resources will be included.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
**field\_buckets**  
  
object

 | 

Field bucket are used to dynamically create a bucket for each value that a field on the document takes. Buckets will be returned in descending order of total ocurrences, up to the provided max\_count. One of filter\_buckets, field\_buckets, or time\_interval\_buckets must be set for a single aggregation.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
field\_buckets.  
**max\_count**  
  
long

 | 

The maximum number of buckets that will be returned.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
field\_buckets.  
**field**  
  
string

 | 

The field whose values will be used to create buckets. A bucket will be created for each unique value this field takes across the resources in the query results or in a bucket (in the case of a nested grouping level). This field must be of type text or enumeration. A list of available fields and their types can be found on the "Search Query Language" page. Payments with empty values for the selected field will be grouped into a bucket, unless explicitly excluded with the literal empty string value ("") in the 'exclude\_values' list.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
field\_buckets.  
**exclude\_values\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

If provided, no buckets will be returned for the values in the list.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
field\_buckets.  
**include\_values\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

If provided, only buckets corresponding to the values in the list will be returned.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
**time\_interval\_buckets**  
  
object

 | 

Time interval buckets are used to create up to a max\_count of buckets of resources based on a given Date field. The interval of each bucket is automatically chosen to create equal intervals of an optional min\_resolution. One of filter\_buckets, field\_buckets or time\_interval\_buckets must be set for a single aggregation.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
time\_interval\_buckets.  
**field**  
  
string

 | 

The field whose values will be used to create buckets - must be a date field. A list of available date fields can be found on the "Search Query Language" page.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
time\_interval\_buckets.  
**min\_resolution**  
  
enum

 | 

An optional minimum interval resolution that should be used when creating buckets.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INTERVAL\_RESOLUTION\_UNKNOWN**  
**INTERVAL\_RESOLUTION\_MONTH:**  
Creates one bucket per month  
**INTERVAL\_RESOLUTION\_DAY:**  
Creates one bucket per day  
**INTERVAL\_RESOLUTION\_HOUR:**  
Creates one bucket per hour  
**INTERVAL\_RESOLUTION\_MINUTE:**  
Creates one bucket per minute  
  
**Default**  
**INTERVAL\_RESOLUTION\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
grouping\_levels\[\].  
time\_interval\_buckets.  
**max\_count**  
  
long

 | 

The maximum number of buckets that must be returned. A smaller amount of buckets may be returned if it is not possible to split the dataset into equal buckets of the requested count (and with the requested minimum resolution).

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
**field\_aggregation**  
  
object

 | 

A simple aggregation which returns a single value calculated based on a field in the resources.  
  
*aggregations\[KEY\] can contain one of **field\_aggregation** or rate\_aggregation*

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
field\_aggregation.  
**field**  
  
string

 | 

The string path of the field that will be used for the field aggregation calculation. Must be provided only when requesting FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM or FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
field\_aggregation.  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of calculation that should be done on the values of the field.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
  
**Default**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
**rate\_aggregation**  
  
object

 | 

The rate of a field aggregation applied to a subset of the resources over the same aggregation applied to all the resources being aggregated. The resulting rate will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
  
*aggregations\[KEY\] can contain one of field\_aggregation or **rate\_aggregation***

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
rate\_aggregation.  
**query**  
  
string

 | 

The filter query that should be applied to find the subset of resources for which we wish to calculate the rate over the total resources in the aggregation.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
rate\_aggregation.  
**field\_aggregation**  
  
object

 | 

The field aggregation that should be applied to the subset of resources returned by the query and to the total resources to calculate the rate.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
rate\_aggregation.  
field\_aggregation.  
**field**  
  
string

 | 

The string path of the field that will be used for the field aggregation calculation. Must be provided only when requesting FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM or FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE.

 |
| 

aggregations\[KEY\].  
rate\_aggregation.  
field\_aggregation.  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of calculation that should be done on the values of the field.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
  
**Default**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

**time\_zone**  
  
string

 | 

An optional timezone which can be used when building time interval buckets. UTC will used if a value is not provided. Time zones may either be specified as an ISO 8601 UTC offset (e.g. '+01:00' or '-08:00') or as a timezone TZ value (e.g. 'America/Los\_Angeles').

 |

instruction\_batches\[\].

 |
| 

instruction\_batches\[\].  
processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

enum

**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**

**processing\_error**  
  
object

 | 

Details on an error that occurred during the processing of the batch. Set when `status` has value `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.

 |
| 

processing\_error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_batchprocessing_BatchGetInstructionBatchesResponse_BatchGetInstructionBatches "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves Instruction Batches with the specified IDs.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.instruction\_batches:read

**Endpoints:** GET /api/v1/instruction-batches:batchGet, GET /api/v1beta/instruction-batches:batchGet

##### [](#request_10 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the InstructionBatches to be retrieved.  
  
Required.  
Min count: 1.  
Max count: 100.

 |

Success Errors

### [](#instructionfile "Copy link to heading")InstructionFile

#### [](#available_methods_5 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_batchprocessing_ListInstructionFilesResponse_ListInstructionFiles) Retrieves Instruction Files that match the provided filters.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_batchprocessing_InstructionFile_GetInstructionFile) Retrieves an Instruction File with the specified ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_batchprocessing_InstructionFile_UpdateInstructionFile) Update the processing status of an Instruction File and the processing status of all related Instruction Batches.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_batchprocessing_BatchGetInstructionFilesResponse_BatchGetInstructionFiles) Retrieves Instruction Files with the specified IDs.
    
-   [Initiate](#_payments_v1_batchprocessing_InstructionFile_InitiateInstructionFile) Initiates asynchronous processing of an INBOUND Instruction File.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_batchprocessing_ListInstructionFilesResponse_ListInstructionFiles "Copy link to heading")List

Retrieves Instruction Files that match the provided filters.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.instruction\_files:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoints:** GET /api/v1/instruction-files, GET /api/v1beta/instruction-files

##### [](#request_11 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned. Required.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page to retrieve. Optional. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

 |
| 

**file\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

File IDs to filter on.

 |
| 

**processing\_statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

Processing statuses to filter on.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The processing status is unknown.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Processing has been completed.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
Processing has errored.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COLLECTING:**  
Resource is collecting before generation.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_SUBMISSION:**  
Resource has been generated and is waiting to be submitted.

 |
| 

**origins**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

Origin of the file to filter on.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_ORIGIN\_UNKNOWN:**  
Origin is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_ORIGIN\_RECEIVED:**  
This indicates the instruction file has been created via an external system and received by Vault Payments.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_ORIGIN\_GENERATED:**  
This indicates the instruction file has been generated by Vault Payments.

 |
| 

**group\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Group IDs to filter on.

 |
| 

**instruction\_file\_specification\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Instruction File Specification IDs to filter on.

 |
| 

**correlation\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Correlation IDs to filter on.

 |

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**

instruction\_files\[\].

object

 | 

Details on an error that occurred during the processing of the file. Set when `status` has value `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`. Output only.

 |
| 

instruction\_files\[\].  
processing\_error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

instruction\_files\[\].  
processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_batchprocessing_InstructionFile_UpdateInstructionFile "Copy link to heading")Update

Update the processing status of an Instruction File and the processing status of all related Instruction Batches. The Instruction File must have an INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_ORIGIN\_GENERATED. An Instruction File may be updated from PROCESSING\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_SUBMISSION to PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED or PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED in order to resolve the submission of a file, and from PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COLLECTING to PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS to manually close the file to new Instructions and mark it for immediate generation and submission.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.instruction\_files:write

**Endpoints:** PUT /api/v1/instruction-files/{instruction\_file.id}, PUT /api/v1beta/instruction-files/{instruction\_file.id}

The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.

The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.

The operation is not implemented.

**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_calendars_BusinessDayDefinition_CreateBusinessDayDefinition "Copy link to heading")Create

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/business-day-definitions

Body parameters

object

Required.

-   [List](#_payments_v1_calendars_ListCalendarsResponse_ListCalendars) Lists and filters Calendars.

#### [](#_payments_v1_calendars_ListCalendarsResponse_ListCalendars "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters Calendars. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.calendars:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/calendars

Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
|

string

 |

#### [](#_payments_v1_calendars_CalendarPeriod_CalculateCalendarPeriod "Copy link to heading")Calculate

Calculates a CalendarPeriod of the Calendar.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.calendars:read

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/calendars:calculatePeriod

##### [](#request_23 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**calendar\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Calendar the Calendar Period needs to be calculated on.

 |
| 

**offset**  
  
integer

 | 

The offset in Calendar Periods to take into account when calculating the Calendar Period. If not specified, defaults to 0 (current Calendar Period).

 |
| 

**reference\_date**  
  
string

 | 

Calculation will be performed using a whole calendar day as reference. Formatted as "YYYY-MM-DD"  
  
*The reference point for the calculation.  
  
This can contain one of **reference\_date** or reference\_date\_time*

 |
| 

**reference\_date\_time**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Calculation will be performed using a point in time as reference.  
  
*The reference point for the calculation.  
  
This can contain one of reference\_date or **reference\_date\_time***

 |

## [](#card_orders "Copy link to heading")Card Orders

### [](#cardorder "Copy link to heading")CardOrder

#### [](#available_methods_10 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cards_card_orders_ListCardOrdersResponse_ListCardOrders) Lists and filters Card Orders.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_cards_card_orders_CardOrder_CreateCardOrder) CreateCardOrder creates a new card order when a new physical card is issued.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_cards_card_orders_CardOrder_UpdateCardOrder) UpdateCardOrder updates the specified Card Order with the updated Card Order resource.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cards_card_orders_BatchGetCardOrdersResponse_BatchGetCardOrders) Retrieves one or more Card Orders by their ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_card_orders_ListCardOrdersResponse_ListCardOrders "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters Card Orders. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.card\_orders:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/cards/card-orders

##### [](#request_24 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

Number of Card Orders to return per page.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Specifies which page of Card Orders to return.

 |
| 

**card\_order\_batch\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Card Order Batch IDs to filter results by.  
  
Max length: 100 characters.

 |
| 

**personalisation\_bureau\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Personalisation Bureau IDs to filter results by.  
  
Max length: 100 characters.

 |
| 

**card\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Card IDs to filter results by.  
  
Max length: 100 characters.

 |
| 

**statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The Orders Statuses to filter results by.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_ORDER\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value  
**CARD\_ORDER\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_PROCESSING:**  
Indicates the card order is waiting to be sent to the personalisation bureau.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_STATUS\_RECEIVED:**  
Indicates the card order has been received by the personalisation bureau.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_STATUS\_SHIPPED:**  
Indicates the card order has been shipped.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_STATUS\_ERROR:**  
Indicates the card order has been rejected/failed to be processed.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Indicates that the card order has been cancelled manually. Usually, due to some error in the data

 |
| 

**types**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The Order Types to filter results by.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_ORDER\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_TYPE\_NEW\_CARD:**  
Indicates the card order is for a new card.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_TYPE\_REPLACEMENT:**  
Indicates the card order is for a card being replaced.

 |
| 

**update\_timestamp\_range**  
  
object

 | 

The update timestamp range to filter results by.

 |
| 

update\_timestamp\_range.  
**from**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Lower end of the range. The range is inclusive of its lower end.

 |
| 

update\_timestamp\_range.  
**to**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Upper end of the range. The range is exclusive of its upper end.

 |

### [](#cardorderbatch "Copy link to heading")CardOrderBatch

#### [](#available_methods_11 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_card_orders_ListCardOrderBatchesResponse_ListCardOrderBatches "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters Card Order Batches. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.card\_order\_batches:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/cards/card-order-batches

##### [](#request_28 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

Number of Card Order Batches to return per page.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Specifies which page of Card Order Batches to return.

 |
| 

**personalisation\_bureau\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Personalisation Bureau IDs to filter results by.

 |
| 

**statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The Orders Statuses to filter results by.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_ORDER\_BATCH\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value  
**CARD\_ORDER\_BATCH\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_PROCESSING:**  
Indicates that card orders can be added to the batch.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_BATCH\_STATUS\_READY\_FOR\_SENDING:**  
Indicates the card order batch is waiting to be sent to the personalisation bureau.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_BATCH\_STATUS\_SENT:**  
Indicates the card order batch has been sent to the personalisation bureau.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_BATCH\_STATUS\_ERROR:**  
Indicates the card order batch has been rejected/failed to be processed.

 |
| 

**types**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The Order Types to filter results by.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_ORDER\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_TYPE\_NEW\_CARD:**  
Indicates the card order is for a new card.  
**CARD\_ORDER\_TYPE\_REPLACEMENT:**  
Indicates the card order is for a card being replaced.

 |
| 

**update\_timestamp\_range**  
  
object

 | 

The update timestamp range to filter results by.

 |
|

|

**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**

**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_card_products_CardProduct_RemoveAccountRanges "Copy link to heading")Remove

Updates a given card product by removing account range IDs and returns the updated resource.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.card\_products:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/cards/card-products/{card\_product\_id}:removeAccountRanges

##### [](#request_30 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**card\_product\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID for the CardProduct to update.

 |

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

Unique UUID identifying the request, used for idempotency.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

**account\_range\_ids\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

Account range IDs to add if not present and adding, or remove if present and removing.  
  
Required.

 |

enum

 |

**Enum values**  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Reissue mode is unknown.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_ACTIVATION:**  
Disable the existing card when the new card is activated.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_EXPIRY:**  
Disable the existing card when the existing card reaches its expiration date.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_REISSUANCE:**

object

**issuing\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

Status to issue new cards in. Valid values are CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE and CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

### [](#cardproduct "Copy link to heading")CardProduct

#### [](#available_methods_13 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cards_card_products_ListCardProductsResponse_ListCardProducts) Lists CardProducts.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_cards_card_products_CardProduct_CreateCardProduct) Creates a new card product and returns the newly created resource.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_cards_card_products_CardProduct_UpdateCardProduct) Updates a given card product and returns the updated resource.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cards_card_products_BatchGetCardProductsResponse_BatchGetCardProducts) Retrieves the card products with the specified IDs.

**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_card_products_CardProduct_CreateCardProduct "Copy link to heading")Create

Creates a new card product and returns the newly created resource.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.card\_products:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/cards/card-products

##### [](#request_32 "Copy link to heading")Request

object

Required.

 |

string

card\_product.  
**status**  
  
enum

 |

An unknown Card product status that indicates unexpected behaviour. Default value.

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_card_products_CardProduct_UpdateCardProduct "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates a given card product and returns the updated resource. Fields allowed for update are status.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.card\_products:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/cards/card-products/{card\_product.id}

##### [](#request_33 "Copy link to heading")Request

**status**  
  
enum

 | 

Indicates if this CardProduct is available to use for Card creation. Required on creation and on status update.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_PRODUCT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown Card product status that indicates unexpected behaviour. Default value.  
**CARD\_PRODUCT\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
A Card product status which allows Cards to be issued.  
**CARD\_PRODUCT\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
A Card product status which disallows Card issuance.  
  
**Default**  
**CARD\_PRODUCT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

**mode**  
  
enum

 | 

The reissuance mode.  
  
**Enum values**  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Reissue mode is unknown.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_ACTIVATION:**  
Disable the existing card when the new card is activated.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_EXPIRY:**  
Disable the existing card when the existing card reaches its expiration date.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_REISSUANCE:**  
Disable the existing card immediately.  
  
**Default**  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_UNKNOWN**

card\_product.  
issuing\_plan.  
**issuing\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

Status to issue new cards in. Valid values are CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE and CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.  
  
**Default**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_card_products_BatchGetCardProductsResponse_BatchGetCardProducts "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves the card products with the specified IDs.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.card\_products:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/cards/card-products:batchGet

##### [](#request_34 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

List of IDs of card products to retrieve.  
  
Required.

 |

##### [](#responses_34 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

|

map \[string: object\]

 |

string

 | 

UUID that uniquely identifies the CardProduct. If not set on creation, a random UUID will be generated.

 |
| 

card\_products\[KEY\].

enum

 |

**Enum values**  
**CARD\_PRODUCT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown Card product status that indicates unexpected behaviour. Default value.  
**CARD\_PRODUCT\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
A Card product status which allows Cards to be issued.  
**CARD\_PRODUCT\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
A Card product status which disallows Card issuance.

string

 | 

How far in advance of the expiration should the card be reissued. Required on creation.

 |
| 

card\_products\[KEY\].  
expiry\_plan.  
reissue.  
**mode**  
  
enum

 | 

The reissuance mode.  
  
**Enum values**  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Reissue mode is unknown.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_ACTIVATION:**  
Disable the existing card when the new card is activated.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_EXPIRY:**  
Disable the existing card when the existing card reaches its expiration date.  
**REISSUE\_MODE\_DISABLE\_ON\_REISSUANCE:**  
Disable the existing card immediately.

 |

card\_products\[KEY\].

object

 |

 |

card\_products\[KEY\].  
issuing\_plan.  
**issuing\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

Status to issue new cards in. Valid values are CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE and CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

string

card\_tokens\[KEY\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

Status of the CardToken resource.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_TOKEN\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_TOKEN\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
An intermediate token status during creation. Possible transitions: ACTIVE, DEACTIVATED.  
**CARD\_TOKEN\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of an active token that can be used for transactions. Possible transitions: SUSPENDED, DEACTIVATED.  
**CARD\_TOKEN\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
The status of a token that has been temporarily suspended. Possible transitions: ACTIVE, DEACTIVATED.  
**CARD\_TOKEN\_STATUS\_DEACTIVATED:**  
The status of a deactivated token. This means that the token has been deleted from the device/server, has expired or has been deactivated by one of token owners. No further transitions are allowed.

## [](#cardholders "Copy link to heading")Cardholders

### [](#cardholder "Copy link to heading")Cardholder

#### [](#available_methods_15 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cards_cardholders_ListCardholdersResponse_ListCardholders) Lists Cardholders.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_cards_cardholders_Cardholder_CreateCardholder) Creates a new Cardholder resource and returns the created resource.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_cards_cardholders_Cardholder_UpdateCardholder) Updates the specified Cardholder with the updated Cardholder resource.
    
-   [Delete](#_google_protobuf_Empty_DeleteCardholder) Deletes the Cardholder resource with the specified ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cards_cardholders_BatchGetCardholdersResponse_BatchGetCardholders) Retrieves the Cardholders with the specified IDs.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_cardholders_ListCardholdersResponse_ListCardholders "Copy link to heading")List

Lists Cardholders. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.cardholders:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/cards/cardholders

Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |

string

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_cardholders_Cardholder_UpdateCardholder "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates the specified Cardholder with the updated Cardholder resource. Fields allowed for update are title, given\_name, last\_name, date\_of\_birth, phone\_number, email, address.address\_1, address.address\_2, address.address\_3, address.address\_4, address.city, address.state, address.postcode, address.country, business\_name and status. If the Cardholder Status is updated to CARDHOLDER\_STATUS\_CLOSED, all Cards associated with the Cardholder will automatically transition to CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.cardholders:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/cards/cardholders/{cardholder.id}

**CARDHOLDER\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**

## [](#cards "Copy link to heading")Cards

### [](#card "Copy link to heading")Card

#### [](#available_methods_16 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_ListCardsResponse_ListCards) Lists and filters Cards.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_Card_UpdateCard) Updates the specified Card with the updated Card resource.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_Card_GetCard) Retrieves the Card with the specified ID.
    
-   [Replace](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_IssueCardResponse_ReplaceCard) Replaces a Card.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_BatchGetCardsResponse_BatchGetCards) Retrieves the Cards with the specified IDs.
    
-   [Issue](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_IssueCardResponse_IssueCard) Issues a new Card.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_ListCardsResponse_ListCards "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters Cards. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.issuance:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/cards/issuance

##### [](#request_43 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

Number of Cards to return per page.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

Specifies which page of Cards to return.

 |
| 

**statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The Card statuses used to filter the Cards list.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

 |
| 

**cardholder\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Cardholder IDs used to filter the Cards list.

 |
| 

**card\_product\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Card Product IDs used to filter the cards list.

 |
| 

**expiration\_timestamp\_range**  
  
object

 | 

The expiration timestamp range used to filter the cards list.

 |
| 

expiration\_timestamp\_range.  
**from**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Lower end of the range. The range is inclusive of its lower end.

 |
| 

expiration\_timestamp\_range.  
**to**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Upper end of the range. The range is exclusive of its upper end.

 |

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_Card_UpdateCard "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates the specified Card with the updated Card resource. Fields allowed for update are cardholder\_id, status, contactless\_transaction\_limits.lvt\_counter\_limit, contactless\_transaction\_limits.lvt\_accumulator\_limit, and contactless\_transaction\_limits.contactless\_amount\_limit.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.issuance:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/cards/issuance/{card.id}

**Default**

**update\_mask**  
  
object

 | 

The field mask used to indicate which fields of the Card are to be updated. The allowed fields are: cardholder\_id, status, contactless\_transaction\_limits.lvt\_counter\_limit, contactless\_transaction\_limits.lvt\_accumulator\_limit, contactless\_transaction\_limits.contactless\_amount\_limit, metadata. If metadata is in the field mask, the full metadata field is replaced with the metadata from the update request. If metadata.x is in the field mask and the key x is present in the metadata field on the update request, only the key x is updated in the metadata. Any existing entries with keys not in the request will not be modified. If metadata.x is in the field mask and the key x is not present in the metadata field on the update request, the key x is removed from the metadata. Any existing entries with keys not in the request will not be modified. Required.  
  
Required.

**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**

An intermediate Card status during creation.

**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**

**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**

**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.  
  
**Default**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

### [](#carddetail "Copy link to heading")CardDetail

#### [](#available_methods_17 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Get](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_CardDetailsResponse_GetCardDetails) Retrieves the Card Details for the Card with the specified ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_CardDetailsResponse_GetCardDetails "Copy link to heading")Get

Retrieves the Card Details for the Card with the specified ID. This endpoint can be called for Cards not in PENDING\_CREATION status.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.issuance:read

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/cards/issuance/{card\_id}:getDetails

string

The ephemeral client public key used to derive the shared encryption key. Hex-encoded ASN.1 DER format 256-bit ECC public key.

 |
|

**signature**  
  
string

 | 

The client SHA-256 signature on the client public key. Hex-encoded.

#### [](#_pci_encryption_EncryptionResponse_InitiateEncryptedSession "Copy link to heading")Initiate

Initiates an ephemeral public key exchange. This allows the derivation of a single-use shared key, to be used in a subsequent call to encrypt/decrypt PCI payload.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.issuance:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/cards/sessions:initiate

enum

Default value.  
**SESSION\_TYPE\_CREATE\_ACCOUNT\_RANGE:**  
A session to initiate a create Account Range request.  
**SESSION\_TYPE\_UPDATE\_PIN:**  
A session to initiate an update PIN request.  
  
**Default**  
**SESSION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_PINResponse_GetPIN "Copy link to heading")Get

#### [](#_google_protobuf_Empty_UpdatePIN "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates the PIN of a Card. Must be called after InitiateEncryptedSession. This endpoint can be called for Cards not in PENDING\_CREATION status.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.issuance:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/cards/issuance/{card\_id}:updatePIN

##### [](#request_53 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**card\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Card.

 |

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The request ID. Used for idempotency.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

**shared\_key\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the shared key from an initiate session encryption response.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

**pin\_block**  
  
string

 | 

The PIN block encrypted under the Zone PIN Key in ISO format 4.  
  
Required.

 |

### [](#pinattempt "Copy link to heading")PINAttempt

#### [](#available_methods_21 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Reset](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_UpdatePINAttemptsResponse_ResetPINAttempts) Sets the remaining PIN attempts back to the value of max PIN attempts.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_issuance_UpdatePINAttemptsResponse_ResetPINAttempts "Copy link to heading")Reset

Sets the remaining PIN attempts back to the value of max PIN attempts. If the Card is SUSPENDED due to the PIN attempts counter being zero, this call will also reset it to ACTIVE.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.issuance:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/cards/issuance/{card\_id}:resetPINAttempts

The ID of the Card.

Required.

string

 | 

The ID of the Card.

 |
| 

**status**  
  
enum

 | 

Status of the Card resource.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

 |
| 

**remaining\_pin\_attempts**  
  
long

 | 

How many PIN attempts remain for this Card.

## [](#cleartext_account_ranges "Copy link to heading")Cleartext Account Ranges

### [](#cleartextaccountrange "Copy link to heading")CleartextAccountRange

#### [](#available_methods_22 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_ListAccountRangesResponse_ListCleartextAccountRanges) ListCleartextAccountRanges lists unencrypted Account Ranges.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_AccountRange_CreateCleartextAccountRange) CreateCleartextAccountRange creates a new cleartext Account Range.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_BatchGetAccountRangesResponse_BatchGetCleartextAccountRanges) BatchGetCleartextAccountRanges retrieves unencrypted Account Ranges by their IDs.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cards_account_ranges_ListAccountRangesResponse_ListCleartextAccountRanges "Copy link to heading")List

ListCleartextAccountRanges lists unencrypted Account Ranges. Only available in the sandbox as a convenience endpoint.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.account\_ranges:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/sandbox/account-ranges

string

 |

account\_ranges\[\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

Status of the AccountRange resource. On creation this is set to ACTIVE.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate account range status during creation which disallows Card issuance.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
Account range status which disallows Card issuance.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
Account range status which allows Cards to be issued.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
Account range status that is terminal, which disallows Card issuance.

long

The length of PANs in this AccountRange. Required on creation.

 |

account\_ranges\[\].  
**range\_from**  
  
string

 | 

The encrypted lower bound of the spanned range. The cleartext value must be 11 digits long, it must span one of the associated BINs and it must not clash with any existing range. Required on creation.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[\].  
**range\_to**  
  
string

 | 

The encrypted upper bound of the spanned range. The cleartext value must be 11 digits long, it must span one of the associated BINs and it must not clash with any existing range. Required on creation.

string (uint64)

 | 

The maximum number of PANs that should be assigned to this AccountRange. This is an indicative limit value, enforced on a best-effort basis. If not set, 30% of the PAN space will be allocated. The PAN check digits are incorporated within this number. For example, the max number of 16 digit PANs prefixed by a single 11 digit number would be 10000, not 100000.

string

UUID that uniquely identifies the AccountRange. If not set on creation, a random UUID will be generated.

account\_ranges\[KEY\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

Status of the AccountRange resource. On creation this is set to ACTIVE.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate account range status during creation which disallows Card issuance.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
Account range status which disallows Card issuance.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
Account range status which allows Cards to be issued.  
**ACCOUNT\_RANGE\_STATUS\_CLOSED:**  
Account range status that is terminal, which disallows Card issuance.

long

account\_ranges\[KEY\].

string

 | 

The encrypted lower bound of the spanned range. The cleartext value must be 11 digits long, it must span one of the associated BINs and it must not clash with any existing range. Required on creation.

 |
| 

account\_ranges\[KEY\].  
**range\_to**  
  
string

 | 

The encrypted upper bound of the spanned range. The cleartext value must be 11 digits long, it must span one of the associated BINs and it must not clash with any existing range. Required on creation.

string (uint64)

**capacity**  
  
string (uint64)

 | 

The maximum number of PANs that should be assigned to this AccountRange. This is an indicative limit value, enforced on a best-effort basis. If not set, 30% of the PAN space will be allocated. The PAN check digits are incorporated within this number. For example, the max number of 16 digit PANs prefixed by a single 11 digit number would be 10000, not 100000.

boolean

#### [](#_google_protobuf_Empty_UpdateCleartextPIN "Copy link to heading")Update

UpdateCleartextPIN updates a Card’s PIN using an unencrypted value. This endpoint can be called for Cards not in PENDING\_CREATION status. Only available in the sandbox as a convenience endpoint.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.issuance:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/sandbox/cards/{card\_id}:updateCleartextPIN

## [](#cores "Copy link to heading")Cores

### [](#core "Copy link to heading")Core

#### [](#available_methods_25 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cores_ListCoresResponse_ListCores) Lists Cores.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_cores_Core_CreateCore) Creates a Core.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_cores_Core_UpdateCore) Updates a Core.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_cores_Core_GetCore) Retrieves a single Core by ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cores_BatchGetCoresResponse_BatchGetCores) Retrieves one or more Cores by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cores_ListCoresResponse_ListCores "Copy link to heading")List

Lists Cores. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.cores:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/cores

### [](#coreversion "Copy link to heading")CoreVersion

#### [](#available_methods_26 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_cores_ListCoreVersionsResponse_ListCoreVersions) Lists and filters CoreVersions.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_cores_CoreVersion_CreateCoreVersion) Creates a CoreVersion.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_cores_CoreVersion_GetCoreVersion) Retrieves a single CoreVersion by ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_cores_BatchGetCoreVersionsResponse_BatchGetCoreVersions) Retrieves one or more CoreVersions by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_cores_ListCoreVersionsResponse_ListCoreVersions "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters CoreVersions. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.core\_versions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/core-versions

The number of results to be listed.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned. Optional.

 |
| 

**core\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Core IDs to filter for.

## [](#dashboards "Copy link to heading")Dashboards

### [](#dashboard "Copy link to heading")Dashboard

#### [](#available_methods_27 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_ListDashboardsResponse_ListDashboards) Retrieves Dashboards that match the provided filters.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_Dashboard_UpdateDashboard) Updates a Dashboard.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_Dashboard_GetDashboard) Retrieves a Dashboard by ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_BatchGetDashboardsResponse_BatchGetDashboards) Retrieves one or more Dashboards by ID.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_Dashboard_CreateDashboard) Creates a Dashboard.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_ListDashboardsResponse_ListDashboards "Copy link to heading")List

Retrieves Dashboards that match the provided filters. By default all dashboards will be returned ordered by update timestamp descending. The current dashboard version can be requested by setting "included\_fields".

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.app.dashboards:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/app/dashboards

**DASHBOARD\_TYPE\_PAYMENTS:**

 |

The field whose values will be used to create buckets. A bucket will be created for each unique value this field takes across the resources in the query results or in a bucket (in the case of a nested grouping level). This field must be of type text or enumeration. A list of available fields and their types can be found on the "Search Query Language" page. Payments with empty values for the selected field will be grouped into a bucket, unless explicitly excluded with the literal empty string value ("") in the 'exclude\_values' list.

**field\_aggregation**

 | 

A simple aggregation which returns a single value calculated based on a field in the resources.  
  
*aggregation can contain one of **field\_aggregation** or rate\_aggregation*

 |
| 

active\_version.  
payments\_dashboard.  
layout.  
widgets\[\].  
aggregation.  
field\_aggregation.  
**field**  
  
string

 | 

The string path of the field that will be used for the field aggregation calculation. Must be provided only when requesting FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM or FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE.

 |
| 

active\_version.  
payments\_dashboard.  
layout.  
widgets\[\].  
aggregation.  
field\_aggregation.  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of calculation that should be done on the values of the field.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.

 |
|

object

 |

*aggregation can contain one of field\_aggregation or **rate\_aggregation***

**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.

Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.

aggregation.  
**field\_aggregation**  
  
object

 | 

A simple aggregation which returns a single value calculated based on a field in the resources.  
  
*aggregation can contain one of **field\_aggregation** or rate\_aggregation*

 |
| 

dashboards\[KEY\].  
active\_version.  
payments\_dashboard.  
layout.  
widgets\[\].  
aggregation.  
field\_aggregation.  
**field**  
  
string

 | 

The string path of the field that will be used for the field aggregation calculation. Must be provided only when requesting FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM or FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE.

 |
| 

dashboards\[KEY\].  
active\_version.  
payments\_dashboard.  
layout.  
widgets\[\].  
aggregation.  
field\_aggregation.  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of calculation that should be done on the values of the field.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.

 |
| 

dashboards\[KEY\].  
active\_version.  
payments\_dashboard.  
layout.  
widgets\[\].  
aggregation.  
**rate\_aggregation**  
  
object

 | 

The rate of a field aggregation applied to a subset of the resources over the same aggregation applied to all the resources being aggregated. The resulting rate will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
  
*aggregation can contain one of field\_aggregation or **rate\_aggregation***

 |
|

enum

 |

**Enum values**  
**CONDITION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Unknown relative condition  
**CONDITION\_TYPE\_GREATER\_OR\_EQUAL:**  
The aggregated value must be greater or equal to the provided relative value.  
**CONDITION\_TYPE\_GREATER:**  
The aggregated value must be greater than the provided relative value.  
**CONDITION\_TYPE\_LESS:**  
The aggregated value must be less than the provided relative value.  
**CONDITION\_TYPE\_LESS\_OR\_EQUAL:**  
The aggregated value must be less or equal to the provided relative value.  
**CONDITION\_TYPE\_EQUAL:**  
The aggregated value must be equal to the provided relative value.

field\_violations\[\].  
**violation\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Type of violation.  
  
**Enum values**  
**UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**INVALID\_FORMAT:**  
Field is not a valid format e.g. email address, UUID, IP Address, URI etc.  
**INVALID\_VALUE:**  
Indicates that a provided field is not equal to one of the specified values.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

### [](#dashboardversion "Copy link to heading")DashboardVersion

#### [](#available_methods_28 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_ListDashboardVersionsResponse_ListDashboardVersions) Retrieves DashboardVersions that match the provided filters.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_DashboardVersion_CreateDashboardVersion) Creates a DashboardVersion.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_DashboardVersion_GetDashboardVersion) Retrieves a Dashboard version by ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_BatchGetDashboardVersionsResponse_BatchGetDashboardVersions) Retrieves one or more Dashboards by ID.
    
-   [Validate](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_ValidateDashboardVersionResponse_ValidateDashboardVersion) Validates a DashboardVersion.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_app_dashboards_ListDashboardVersionsResponse_ListDashboardVersions "Copy link to heading")List

Retrieves DashboardVersions that match the provided filters. By default all dashboard versions will be returned ordered by create timestamp descending. The current dashboard version can be requested by setting "included\_fields".

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.app.dashboard\_versions:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/app/dashboard-versions

##### [](#request_75 "Copy link to heading")Request

| --- | --- |

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. Optional. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**dashboard\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Dashboard IDs the DashboardVersions are to be filtered on. Optional.
