enum

 | 

The type of calculation that should be done on the values of the field.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.

default\_filter\_values.  
**date\_filter\_field**  
  
enum

 | 

This is the field on which the date filter will be applied. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**DATE\_FILTER\_FIELDS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Unknown date filter. Invalid.  
**DATE\_FILTER\_FIELDS\_SETTLEMENT\_DATE:**  
Use the Payment settlement date for filtering the data presented in the Dashboard.  
**DATE\_FILTER\_FIELDS\_CREATE\_TIMESTAMP:**  
Use the Payment creation timestamp for filtering the data presented in the Dashboard.

**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of calculation that should be done on the values of the field.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
  
**Default**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

**field\_aggregation**

 | 

A simple aggregation which returns a single value calculated based on a field in the resources.

 |
|

widgets\[\].  
aggregation.  
field\_aggregation.  
**field**  
  
string

 | 

The string path of the field that will be used for the field aggregation calculation. Must be provided only when requesting FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM or FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE.

 |
| 

payments\_dashboard.  
layout.  
widgets\[\].  
aggregation.  
field\_aggregation.  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of calculation that should be done on the values of the field.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.

 |
|

**INVALID\_FORMAT:**  
Field is not a valid format e.g. email address, UUID, IP Address, URI etc.  
**INVALID\_VALUE:**  
Indicates that a provided field is not equal to one of the specified values.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

 |

**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.

Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.

 |

**DATE\_FILTER\_FIELDS\_SETTLEMENT\_DATE:**  
Use the Payment settlement date for filtering the data presented in the Dashboard.  
**DATE\_FILTER\_FIELDS\_CREATE\_TIMESTAMP:**

enum

 |

*Date filters can either be timeframes (relative the moment someone is viewing the dashboard) or a fixed datetime range.

**TIMEFRAME\_FILTER\_THIS\_MONTH:**  
Applies a filter on the chosen date field to only aggregate payments data for the current month  
**TIMEFRAME\_FILTER\_THIS\_YEAR:**  
Applies a filter on the chosen date field to only aggregate payments data for the current year  
  
**Default**  
**TIMEFRAME\_FILTER\_UNKNOWN**

**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of calculation that should be done on the values of the field.  
  
**Enum values**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_COUNT:**  
Counts the number of resources in the filter query results or in a bucket. By default, it will count the top-level resources. To count a nested resource (such as instructions) instead, a field value must also be provided which contains the path of the unique ID of the nested resource.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_SUM:**  
Sums up the values of a given field across all resources in the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_AVERAGE:**  
Calculates the mean value of a given field across allin the query results or in a bucket. The result will have a precision of 2 decimal points.  
  
**Default**  
**FIELD\_AGGREGATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

## [](#instruction_file_specification "Copy link to heading")Instruction File Specification

### [](#instructionfilespecification "Copy link to heading")InstructionFileSpecification

#### [](#available_methods_31 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_instruction_file_specifications_ListInstructionFileSpecificationsResponse_ListInstructionFileSpecifications) Lists and filters InstructionFileSpecifications.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_instruction_file_specifications_InstructionFileSpecification_CreateInstructionFileSpecification) Creates an InstructionFileSpecification.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_instruction_file_specifications_InstructionFileSpecification_GetInstructionFileSpecification) Retrieves a single InstructionFileSpecifications by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_instruction_file_specifications_InstructionFileSpecification_UpdateInstructionFileSpecification) Updates an InstructionFileSpecification.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_instruction_file_specifications_BatchGetInstructionFileSpecificationsResponse_BatchGetInstructionFileSpecifications) Retrieves one or more InstructionFileSpecifications by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_instruction_file_specifications_ListInstructionFileSpecificationsResponse_ListInstructionFileSpecifications "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters InstructionFileSpecifications. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.instruction\_file\_specifications:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoints:** GET /api/v1/instruction-file-specifications, GET /api/v1beta/instruction-file-specifications

Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**types**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The InstructionFileSpecification types to filter for.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
The type of the InstructionFileSpecification is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_RECEIVED:**  
The InstructionFileSpecification is used to process InstructionFiles with origin 'RECEIVED'. All related `InstructionFileSpecificationVersion`s must implement a `debulk_func`, and optionally may implement an `unmarshal_func`.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_GENERATED:**  
The InstructionFileSpecification is used to process InstructionFiles with origin 'GENERATED'. All related `InstructionFileSpecificationVersion`s must implement a `bulk_func`, and optionally may implement a `marshal_func`. Value related to beta functionality. Its interface is subject to change.

 |
| 

**fields\_to\_include**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The fields to include when retrieving the list of resources. Only if present here will the field be included in the response.  
  
**Enum values**

Include the active Version for the resource.

Creates an InstructionFileSpecification.

instruction\_file\_specification.  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of the InstructionFileSpecification. Determines whether it processes `InstructionFile` with origin `RECEIVED` or `GENERATED`. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
The type of the InstructionFileSpecification is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_RECEIVED:**  
The InstructionFileSpecification is used to process InstructionFiles with origin 'RECEIVED'. All related `InstructionFileSpecificationVersion`s must implement a `debulk_func`, and optionally may implement an `unmarshal_func`.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_GENERATED:**  
The InstructionFileSpecification is used to process InstructionFiles with origin 'GENERATED'. All related `InstructionFileSpecificationVersion`s must implement a `bulk_func`, and optionally may implement a `marshal_func`. Value related to beta functionality. Its interface is subject to change.  
  
**Default**  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

The type of the InstructionFileSpecification. Determines whether it processes `InstructionFile` with origin `RECEIVED` or `GENERATED`. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
The type of the InstructionFileSpecification is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_RECEIVED:**  
The InstructionFileSpecification is used to process InstructionFiles with origin 'RECEIVED'. All related `InstructionFileSpecificationVersion`s must implement a `debulk_func`, and optionally may implement an `unmarshal_func`.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_GENERATED:**  
The InstructionFileSpecification is used to process InstructionFiles with origin 'GENERATED'. All related `InstructionFileSpecificationVersion`s must implement a `bulk_func`, and optionally may implement a `marshal_func`. Value related to beta functionality. Its interface is subject to change.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.instruction\_file\_specifications:read

**Endpoints:** GET /api/v1/instruction-file-specifications:batchGet, GET /api/v1beta/instruction-file-specifications:batchGet

**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
The type of the InstructionFileSpecification is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_RECEIVED:**  
The InstructionFileSpecification is used to process InstructionFiles with origin 'RECEIVED'. All related `InstructionFileSpecificationVersion`s must implement a `debulk_func`, and optionally may implement an `unmarshal_func`.  
**INSTRUCTION\_FILE\_SPECIFICATION\_TYPE\_GENERATED:**  
The InstructionFileSpecification is used to process InstructionFiles with origin 'GENERATED'. All related `InstructionFileSpecificationVersion`s must implement a `bulk_func`, and optionally may implement a `marshal_func`. Value related to beta functionality. Its interface is subject to change.

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

## [](#instruction_flows "Copy link to heading")Instruction Flows

### [](#instructionflow "Copy link to heading")InstructionFlow

#### [](#available_methods_33 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_instruction_flows_ListInstructionFlowsResponse_ListInstructionFlows) Lists and filters InstructionFlows.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_instruction_flows_InstructionFlow_CreateInstructionFlow) Creates an InstructionFlow.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_instruction_flows_InstructionFlow_GetInstructionFlow) Retrieves a single InstructionFlow by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_instruction_flows_InstructionFlow_UpdateInstructionFlow) Updates an InstructionFlow.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_instruction_flows_BatchGetInstructionFlowsResponse_BatchGetInstructionFlows) Retrieves one or more InstructionFlows by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_instruction_flows_ListInstructionFlowsResponse_ListInstructionFlows "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters InstructionFlows. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.instruction\_flows:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/instruction-flows

#### [](#_payments_v1_instruction_flows_InstructionFlowVersion_CreateInstructionFlowVersion "Copy link to heading")Create

Creates an InstructionFlowVersion.

As well as a standard REST endpoint, this endpoint supports uploading an instruction flow as a single Python file. In this mode, the Python file should be uploaded as the body of the request, and the caller should ensure to set the HTTP header `Content-Type: text/x-python`.

They should additionally set the `X-Tm-Request-Id` HTTP header to the same value they would normally use for the `request_id` field on a JSON request. The standard idempotency guarantees apply to this header as to `request_id` normally.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.instruction\_flow\_versions:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/instruction-flow-versions

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/instruction-flow-versions:validate

##### [](#request_102 "Copy link to heading")Request

 |

 |

##### [](#responses_102 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**is\_valid**  
  
boolean

 | 

True if the Instruction Flow Version passes validation.

 |
| 

**error**  
  
object

 | 

The errors found in validation.

 |
| 

error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

## [](#instructions "Copy link to heading")Instructions

### [](#instruction "Copy link to heading")Instruction

#### [](#available_methods_35 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_instructions_ListInstructionsResponse_ListInstructions) Retrieves Instructions that match the provided filters.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_instruction_Instruction_GetInstruction) Retrieves an Instruction with the specified ID.
    
-   [Retry](#_payments_v1_instructions_RetryInstructionResponse_RetryInstruction) Allows retrying of an Instruction which has failed on an Instruction Flow step and which has terminated processing with `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_instruction_Instruction_UpdateInstruction) Allows updating an Instruction which has terminated processing with `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.
    
-   [Repair](#_payments_v1_instructions_RepairInstructionResponse_RepairInstruction) Provides advanced capabilities for repairing an Instruction which has terminated processing with `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_instructions_BatchGetInstructionsResponse_BatchGetInstructions) Retrieves Instructions with the specified IDs.
    
-   [BulkRetry](#_payments_v1_instructions_BulkRetryInstructionsResponse_BulkRetryInstructions) Allows retrying of multiple Instructions which have failed on an Instruction Flow step and terminated processing with `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.
    
-   [Initiate](#_payments_v1_instructions_InitiateInstructionResponse_InitiateInstruction) Initiates asynchronous processing of an Instruction and acknowledges successful receipt by returning the ID of the submitted instruction and the selected instruction flow.
    
-   [Process](#_payments_v1_instruction_Instruction_ProcessInstruction) Processes an Instruction synchronously, returning the final state of the Instruction once processing completes.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_instructions_ListInstructionsResponse_ListInstructions "Copy link to heading")List

Retrieves Instructions that match the provided filters. By default all instructions will be returned ordered by update timestamp descending. Not guaranteed to return the latest changes to an instruction until a corresponding event has been emitted on the event streaming API. The payload and history can be requested by setting "included\_fields".

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.instructions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/instructions

**processing\_statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The processing statuses to filter on. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The processing status is unknown.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Instruction processing has completed.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
An error has occurred during the processing of the Instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**  
Instruction processing is waiting for an event to continue.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
Instruction processing is queued behind a currently processing matched instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**  
Instruction has been interrupted by another instruction and its processing has been suspended until the interrupting instruction completes processing.

 |
| 

**outcomes**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The outcomes to filter on. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OUTCOME\_UNKNOWN:**  
Outcome of the instruction is unknown.  
**OUTCOME\_PENDING:**  
Instruction is still processing and does not have an outcome yet.  
**OUTCOME\_ACCEPTED:**  
Instruction has been accepted.  
**OUTCOME\_REJECTED:**  
Instruction has been rejected.

 |

**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**

**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INITIATION:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
An error has occurred during the processing of the Instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**  
Instruction processing is waiting for an event to continue.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
Instruction processing is queued behind a currently processing matched instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**

instructions\[\].

 |
| 

instructions\[\].  
processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

**type**  
  
enum

The type of Instruction message. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**

**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_AUTHORISATION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card authorisation initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INQUIRY\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card (balance)inquiry initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is used to move funds from a debtor account to a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card financial initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REVERSAL\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a reversal initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CARD\_MANAGEMENT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card management initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RESOLUTION\_OF\_INVESTIGATION:**  
The type represents a resolution of investigation response, indicating acceptance or rejection of a previous request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_PAYMENT\_RETURN:**  
The type represents a payment return, used for returning a previously received credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_ADMINISTRATIVE\_INITIATION:**  
The type is an administrative initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer credit transfer initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_DIRECT\_DEBIT:**  
The type is used to collect funds from a debtor account for a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_DIRECT\_DEBIT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer direct debit initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RECEIPT\_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:**  
The type is a receipt acknowledgement.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INSTITUTION\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is a financial institution credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_INITIATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate initiation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_AMENDMENT\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate amendment request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_ACCEPTANCE\_REPORT:**  
The type is mandate acceptance report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_DEBIT\_CREDIT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer Debit and Credit Notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FILE\_ACTION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is file action initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FRAUD\_DISPOSITION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is fraud disposition initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a customer payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MESSAGE\_REJECT:**  
The type is a message reject.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is an investigation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_RESPONSE:**  
The type is an investigation response.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_ACCOUNT\_REPORT:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer account report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_SYSTEM\_EVENT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a system event notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CLAIM\_NON\_RECEIPT:**  
The type is a claim non receipt.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REQUEST\_TO\_MODIFY\_PAYMENT:**  
The type is a request to modify payment.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_REVERSAL:**

#### [](#_payments_v1_instruction_Instruction_GetInstruction "Copy link to heading")Get

Retrieves an Instruction with the specified ID. Not guaranteed to return the latest changes to an instruction until a corresponding event has been emitted on the event streaming API.

This endpoint also supports [ISO 20022](https://www.iso20022.org/) XML messages as the body of the response.

The caller can determine the response type by providing the HTTP header `Accept: application/json` or `Accept: application/xml`. If not provided, the value of the `Content-Type` header will be used as a default.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.instructions:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/instructions/{id}

##### [](#request_104 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the instruction to be retrieved.

 |

Success Errors

**processing\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The processing status of the Instruction.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The processing status is unknown.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Instruction processing has completed.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
An error has occurred during the processing of the Instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**  
Instruction processing is waiting for an event to continue.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
Instruction processing is queued behind a currently processing matched instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**  
Instruction has been interrupted by another instruction and its processing has been suspended until the interrupting instruction completes processing.

 |
| 

**processing\_mode**  
  
enum

 | 

Defines the processing mode for the Instruction. Derived from the assigned Instruction Flow Version. Output only.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_MODE\_QUEUE:**  
Instruction will be queued behind any incomplete matched instructions. Default behaviour.  
**PROCESSING\_MODE\_INTERRUPT:**  
Instruction will interrupt previous WAITING matched instruction if present.

processing\_error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
The type is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_AUTHORISATION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card authorisation initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INQUIRY\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card (balance)inquiry initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is used to move funds from a debtor account to a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card financial initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REVERSAL\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a reversal initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CARD\_MANAGEMENT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card management initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RESOLUTION\_OF\_INVESTIGATION:**  
The type represents a resolution of investigation response, indicating acceptance or rejection of a previous request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_PAYMENT\_RETURN:**  
The type represents a payment return, used for returning a previously received credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_ADMINISTRATIVE\_INITIATION:**  
The type is an administrative initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer credit transfer initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_DIRECT\_DEBIT:**  
The type is used to collect funds from a debtor account for a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_DIRECT\_DEBIT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer direct debit initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RECEIPT\_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:**  
The type is a receipt acknowledgement.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INSTITUTION\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is a financial institution credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_INITIATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate initiation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_AMENDMENT\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate amendment request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_ACCEPTANCE\_REPORT:**  
The type is mandate acceptance report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_DEBIT\_CREDIT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer Debit and Credit Notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FILE\_ACTION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is file action initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FRAUD\_DISPOSITION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is fraud disposition initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a customer payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MESSAGE\_REJECT:**  
The type is a message reject.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is an investigation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_RESPONSE:**  
The type is an investigation response.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_ACCOUNT\_REPORT:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer account report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_SYSTEM\_EVENT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a system event notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CLAIM\_NON\_RECEIPT:**  
The type is a claim non receipt.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REQUEST\_TO\_MODIFY\_PAYMENT:**  
The type is a request to modify payment.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_REVERSAL:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment reversal.

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

history\[\].  
step.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
**posting\_instruction\_chain**  
  
string

 | 

An identifier to chain posting instructions together. This value will be used with the instruction’s correlation ID to create an ID that will be the same throughout a financial process’s lifecycle.  
  
Optional, will be set to a default value automatically and will not need to be set unless a payment lifecycle contains multiple chains of posting instructions.  
  
Only applies to chainable posting instructions: OutboundAuthorisation, InboundAuthorisation, AuthorisationAdjustment, Settlement, Release  
  
e.g. 3 Posting Instructions are made for the same correlation ID:  
  
An OutboundAuthorisation posting is made with chain "primary" another OutboundAuthorisation posting is made with chain "additional\_fees" then a Settlement posting with chain "additional\_fees" will settle the second posting

 |
|

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
posting\_violations\[\].  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of violation.  
  
**Enum values**  
**POSTING\_VIOLATION\_CLIENT\_TRANSACTION\_ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
An OutboundAuthorisation, InboundAuthorisation, Transfer, OutboundHardSettlement or InboundHardSettlement specifies a `client_transaction_id` which already exists in the namespace of the `client_id`.  
**POSTING\_VIOLATION\_CLIENT\_TRANSACTION\_DOES\_NOT\_EXIST:**  
An AuthorisationAdjustment, Settlement, Release is referring to a non existent client transaction.  
**POSTING\_VIOLATION\_ADJUSTMENT\_YIELDS\_AUTHORISATION\_WITH\_NEGATIVE\_AMOUNT:**  
An AuthorisationAdjustment yields an authorisation with a negative amount.  
**POSTING\_VIOLATION\_CLIENT\_TRANSACTION\_CLOSED:**  
An instruction is attempting to mutate a client transaction that has been closed.  
**POSTING\_VIOLATION\_CLIENT\_TRANSACTION\_INVALID\_OPERATION:**  
An instruction is being added to a client transaction where the `value_timestamp` is not strictly later than the current latest instruction, or the instruction being processed would create a client transaction which has a combination of CustomInstructions and other instruction types.

 |
|

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
account\_violations\[\].  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of violation.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_ACCOUNT\_NOT\_PRESENT:**  
The instruction’s target account is not present.  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_INVALID:**  
The instruction’s target account is in a status that doesn’t allow postings (for example, CLOSED or PENDING\_OPENING).  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_UNSUPPORTED\_DENOMINATION:**  
The instruction’s target account does not support the posted denomination.  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_PAYMENT\_DEVICE\_INVALID:**  
The instruction’s payment device token resolved to a payment device that has an invalid status as of this batch’s value\_timestamp.  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_MULTIPLE\_PROCESSING\_GROUPS:**  
The instruction affects multiple accounts that do not all share the same processing group.  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_INTERNAL\_ACCOUNT\_PROCESSING\_LABEL\_NOT\_PRESENT:**  
The instruction’s internal account processing label is not present.  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_SUB\_ACCOUNT\_NOT\_PRESENT:**  
The instruction’s target Sub-Account associated to the Account is not present.  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_SUB\_ACCOUNT\_STATUS\_INVALID:**  
The instruction’s target Sub-Account is in a status that doesn’t allow postings (for example, CLOSED, or PENDING).  
**ACCOUNT\_VIOLATION\_ADDRESS\_NOT\_PERMITTED:**  
The instruction’s target address is not a permitted address for the Sub-Account type.

 |
|

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
restriction\_violations\[\].  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of restriction violation. For instructions instructed prior to Vault version 5.4, this will be returned as `RESTRICTION_VIOLATION_TYPE_UNKNOWN`.  
  
**Enum values**  
**RESTRICTION\_VIOLATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown restriction type.  
**RESTRICTION\_VIOLATION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction violation type that was caused by a restriction which prevents credits.  
**RESTRICTION\_VIOLATION\_TYPE\_PREVENT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction violation type that was caused by a restriction which prevents debits.  
**RESTRICTION\_VIOLATION\_TYPE\_REVIEW\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction violation type that was caused by a restriction which requires reviewing credits.  
**RESTRICTION\_VIOLATION\_TYPE\_REVIEW\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction violation type that was caused by a restriction which requires reviewing debits.  
**RESTRICTION\_VIOLATION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_CREDITS:**  
A restriction violation type that was caused by a restriction which limits credits.  
**RESTRICTION\_VIOLATION\_TYPE\_LIMIT\_DEBITS:**  
A restriction violation type that was caused by a restriction which limits debits.

 |
|

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
**booking\_localised\_date\_time**  
  
string

 | 

An RFC 3339 compliant date/time string representing the `booking_timestamp` of the PostingInstructionBatch, localised into the time zone of the processing group associated with accounts referenced in this PostingInstruction. As the processing group may change over time, this field will not be populated for future-booked postings. Cannot be set in a VaultCorePostingsStep Posting Function.  
  
**Deprecated** as of release **5.10**, and will be removed no earlier than release **7.0**  
*This field is being removed. Clients should instead derive localised date times from the UTC booking\_timestamp using their own knowledge of the relevant timezone and calendar.*

 |
| 

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
**value\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time at which all committed postings of this PostingInstruction will affect balances. For most cases, including real time payments or fund movements, this does not require setting and will default to the generated `insertion_timestamp`. Should only be set for backdated and future-dated instructions and must be between 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z and the current time + 90 calendar days, inclusive. Defaults to the `insertion_timestamp` in UTC.

 |
| 

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
**booking\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time at which all committed postings of this PostingInstruction will be booked. For most cases, including real time payments or fund movements, this does not require setting and will default to the `insertion_timestamp`. Should only be set for back-booked and future-booked instructions and must be between 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z and the current time + 90 calendar days, inclusive. Defaults to the `insertion_timestamp` in UTC.

 |
|

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
authorisation\_adjustment.  
**amount**  
  
string

 | 

A delta amount. The sign of the delta can be given explicitly (`"+3.40"`, `"-20"`) or implicitly if it is positive (e.g "3.40" is the same as "+3.40").  
  
*The amount of the AuthorisationAdjustment, which can be specified as a delta (the difference between the previous amount and the new amount) or as a new total authorised amount. On a response, it is recommended to inspect the `delta_amount` and `authorised_amount` fields as they contain the same information but, unlike the `adjustment_amount.amount` or `adjustment_amount.replacement_amount` fields, they are guaranteed to be set on an accepted PostingInstructionBatch.  
  
authorisation\_adjustment can contain one of **amount** or replacement\_amount*

 |
| 

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
posting\_instructions\[\].  
authorisation\_adjustment.  
**replacement\_amount**  
  
string

 | 

A new amount, to replace the existing authorised amount.  
  
*The amount of the AuthorisationAdjustment, which can be specified as a delta (the difference between the previous amount and the new amount) or as a new total authorised amount. On a response, it is recommended to inspect the `delta_amount` and `authorised_amount` fields as they contain the same information but, unlike the `adjustment_amount.amount` or `adjustment_amount.replacement_amount` fields, they are guaranteed to be set on an accepted PostingInstructionBatch.  
  
authorisation\_adjustment can contain one of amount or **replacement\_amount***

 |
|

postings\[\].  
**internal\_account\_processing\_label**  
  
string

 | 

You can use a processing label to specify an Internal Account as part of a Custom Instruction instead of directly referencing an account ID. If you use a processing label in a CustomInstruction, there must be at least one posting in the same instruction that does not use a label, using the account\_id instead. The internal account then resolves using the processing group of the account identified by this account\_id. If a posting of a CustomInstruction using a processing label does not contain an account\_id, this request will fail. You also cannot instruct a CustomInstruction in which labels are used in all its postings.  
  
**Multiple Processing Groups are only available as an Extension.**

 |
|

 |
| 

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
**value\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time at which all committed postings of this batch’s posting instructions will affect balances. For most cases, including real time payments or fund movements, this does not require setting and will default to the generated `insertion_timestamp`. Only backdating of posting instruction batches is supported; this means that you cannot set them to be in the future, as determined by the clock of the ledger service. The earliest allowed value is 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Optional; defaults to the insertion timestamp in UTC. Can not be set if the value\_timestamp in the PostingInstruction is set. If set at the PostingInstructionBatch level, the response will have value\_timestamp populated on both the PostingInstructionBatch and in the PostingInstructions. This is also the case when defaulting to the insertion timestamp.

 |
| 

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
**booking\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Optional. Specifies the booking time of all committed postings of this batch’s Posting Instructions. Defaults to `value_timestamp` (which, in turn, defaults to `insertion_timestamp`), and by extension is populated on the response in the same manner. Can only be used for back-booked Posting Instruction Batches (PIBs), and can only be set if `value_timestamp` is also passed in the request; in which case `booking_timestamp` must be later than `value_timestamp`, and be set at the same level as the `value_timestamp`.

 |
| 

history\[\].  
step.  
vault\_core\_postings.  
posting\_instruction\_batch.  
**source\_insertion\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

Specifies the time this posting instruction batch was inserted in the source core banking engine. Will always have the same value as `insertion_timestamp` unless the posting instruction batch was migrated into Vault via the Posting Migration API. Cannot be set in a VaultCorePostingsStep Posting Function.

**Enum values**  
**UNKNOWN:**

**INVALID\_FORMAT:**

**INVALID\_VALUE:**

**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

#### [](#_payments_v1_instructions_RetryInstructionResponse_RetryInstruction "Copy link to heading")Retry

Allows retrying of an Instruction which has failed on an Instruction Flow step and which has terminated processing with `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`. This will move the Instruction back to `PROCESSING_STATUS_IN_PROGRESS` and cause it to resume processing asynchronously.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.instructions:write, payments.instructions:retry

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/instructions/{id}:retry

##### [](#request_105 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**id**  
  
string

 | 

ID of the instruction to be retried.

 |

##### [](#responses_105 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

400 Invalid Argument 401 Unauthenticated 403 Permission Denied 404 Not Found 429 Resource Exhausted 500 Internal 500 Unknown 503 Unavailable 504 Deadline Exceeded

Returned on receipt of invalid input regardless of the system state

#### [](#_payments_v1_instruction_Instruction_UpdateInstruction "Copy link to heading")Update

Allows updating an Instruction which has terminated processing with `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`. The only allowed update is setting the `processing_status` to `PROCESSING_STATUS_CANCELLED`.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.instructions:write, payments.instructions:update

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/instructions/{instruction.id}

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
An error has occurred during the processing of the Instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**  
Instruction processing is waiting for an event to continue.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
Instruction processing is queued behind a currently processing matched instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**  
Instruction has been interrupted by another instruction and its processing has been suspended until the interrupting instruction completes processing.

**processing\_error**  
  
object

 | 

Details on an error that occurred during the processing of the Instruction. Set when `processing_status` has value `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.

 |
| 

processing\_error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_instructions_RepairInstructionResponse_RepairInstruction "Copy link to heading")Repair

Provides advanced capabilities for repairing an Instruction which has terminated processing with `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.

Repairs are intended for rescuing Instructions that have entered a bad state, typically due to a bug in the Instruction Flow, and allow making certain changes that are prohibited during processing. These actions should be taken with caution and require an understanding of the underlying Instruction Flow. Repairs should be an exception, and are not intended to form part of a routine process.

A repair consists of three steps: 1. Rewinding the Instruction to an earlier state (optional) 2. Updating fields on the Instruction, which also allows replacing its flow (optional) 3. Resuming processing of the instruction

Any steps which are re-processed will use new idempotency keys, e.g. when making calls to integrations. A repair can be previewed by using the dry-run option. Repairs (but not their side-effects) can be undone by rewinding the Instruction to an earlier state using another repair.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.instructions:write, payments.instructions:repair

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/instructions/{instruction.id}:repair

instruction.  
**direction**  
  
enum

 | 

The direction of the Instruction. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_DIRECTION\_UNKNOWN:**  
The Instruction direction is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_DIRECTION\_INBOUND:**  
The Instruction direction is inbound.  
**INSTRUCTION\_DIRECTION\_OUTBOUND:**  
The Instruction direction is outbound.

 |
| 

instruction.  
**processing\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The processing status of the Instruction.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The processing status is unknown.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Instruction processing has completed.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
An error has occurred during the processing of the Instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**  
Instruction processing is waiting for an event to continue.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
Instruction processing is queued behind a currently processing matched instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**  
Instruction has been interrupted by another instruction and its processing has been suspended until the interrupting instruction completes processing.

 |
| 

instruction.  
**processing\_mode**  
  
enum

 | 

Defines the processing mode for the Instruction. Derived from the assigned Instruction Flow Version. Output only.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_MODE\_QUEUE:**  
Instruction will be queued behind any incomplete matched instructions. Default behaviour.  
**PROCESSING\_MODE\_INTERRUPT:**  
Instruction will interrupt previous WAITING matched instruction if present.

 |
| 

instruction.  
**processing\_error**  
  
object

 | 

Details on an error that occurred during the processing of the Instruction. Set when `processing_status` has value `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.

 |
| 

instruction.  
processing\_error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

instruction.  
processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

instruction.  
**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of Instruction message. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
The type is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_AUTHORISATION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card authorisation initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INQUIRY\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card (balance)inquiry initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is used to move funds from a debtor account to a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card financial initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REVERSAL\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a reversal initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CARD\_MANAGEMENT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card management initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RESOLUTION\_OF\_INVESTIGATION:**  
The type represents a resolution of investigation response, indicating acceptance or rejection of a previous request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_PAYMENT\_RETURN:**  
The type represents a payment return, used for returning a previously received credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_ADMINISTRATIVE\_INITIATION:**  
The type is an administrative initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer credit transfer initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_DIRECT\_DEBIT:**  
The type is used to collect funds from a debtor account for a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_DIRECT\_DEBIT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer direct debit initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RECEIPT\_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:**  
The type is a receipt acknowledgement.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INSTITUTION\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is a financial institution credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_INITIATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate initiation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_AMENDMENT\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate amendment request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_ACCEPTANCE\_REPORT:**  
The type is mandate acceptance report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_DEBIT\_CREDIT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer Debit and Credit Notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FILE\_ACTION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is file action initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FRAUD\_DISPOSITION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is fraud disposition initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a customer payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MESSAGE\_REJECT:**  
The type is a message reject.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is an investigation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_RESPONSE:**  
The type is an investigation response.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_ACCOUNT\_REPORT:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer account report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_SYSTEM\_EVENT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a system event notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CLAIM\_NON\_RECEIPT:**  
The type is a claim non receipt.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REQUEST\_TO\_MODIFY\_PAYMENT:**  
The type is a request to modify payment.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_REVERSAL:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment reversal.

#### [](#_payments_v1_instructions_BatchGetInstructionsResponse_BatchGetInstructions "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves Instructions with the specified IDs. Not guaranteed to return the latest changes to an instruction until a corresponding event has been emitted on the event streaming API. The payload and history can be requested by setting "included\_fields".

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.instructions:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/instructions:batchGet

##### [](#request_108 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the instructions to be retrieved.  
  
Required.  
Min count: 1.  
Max count: 100.

 |
| 

**fields\_to\_include**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

A list of additional fields to include within the response.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INCLUDE\_FIELD\_INSTRUCTION\_PAYLOAD:**  
Include the instruction type specific payload.  
**INCLUDE\_FIELD\_INSTRUCTION\_HISTORY:**  
Include the instruction history.

processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

###### BadRequest

 
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**@type**  
  
string

 | 

A type name to identify this detail.

**field\_violations\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

Describes all violations in a request.

 |
| 

field\_violations\[\].  
**field**  
  
string

 | 

A path leading to a field in the request body. Formatted in JSONPath, so that a 'resource' with field 'x' would return 'resource.x'.

 |
| 

field\_violations\[\].  
**violation\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

Type of violation.  
  
**Enum values**  
**UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**INVALID\_FORMAT:**  
Field is not a valid format e.g. email address, UUID, IP Address, URI etc.  
**INVALID\_VALUE:**  
Indicates that a provided field is not equal to one of the specified values.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

 |
| 

field\_violations\[\].  
**description**  
  
string

 | 

A description of why the request field is invalid.

 |

Returned when the request could not be authenticated.

#### [](#_payments_v1_instructions_BulkRetryInstructionsResponse_BulkRetryInstructions "Copy link to heading")BulkRetry

Allows retrying of multiple Instructions which have failed on an Instruction Flow step and terminated processing with `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`. This will move the Instructions back to `PROCESSING_STATUS_IN_PROGRESS` and cause them to resume processing asynchronously.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.instructions:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/instructions:bulkRetry

A URL/resource name that uniquely identifies the type of the serialized protocol buffer message. This string must contain at least one "/" character. The last segment of the URL’s path must represent the fully qualified name of the type (as in `path/google.protobuf.Duration`). The name should be in a canonical form (e.g., leading "." is not accepted).  
  
In practice, teams usually precompile into the binary all types that they expect it to use in the context of Any. However, for URLs which use the scheme `http`, `https`, or no scheme, one can optionally set up a type server that maps type URLs to message definitions as follows:  
  
\* If no scheme is provided, `https` is assumed. \* An HTTP GET on the URL must yield a \[google.protobuf.Type\]\[\] value in binary format, or produce an error. \* Applications are allowed to cache lookup results based on the URL, or have them precompiled into a binary to avoid any lookup. Therefore, binary compatibility needs to be preserved on changes to types. (Use versioned type names to manage breaking changes.)  
  
Note: this functionality is not currently available in the official protobuf release, and it is not used for type URLs beginning with type.googleapis.com.  
  
Schemes other than `http`, `https` (or the empty scheme) might be used with implementation specific semantics.

#### [](#_payments_v1_instructions_InitiateInstructionResponse_InitiateInstruction "Copy link to heading")Initiate

Initiates asynchronous processing of an Instruction and acknowledges successful receipt by returning the ID of the submitted instruction and the selected instruction flow. This is the recommended way to submit Instructions for processing when the caller does not require the final result, and is suitable for all schemes and message types. Processing of the instruction is guaranteed once acknowledged. The final result of processing is made available on the Instructions event stream. Configuration properties may take a short amount of time to be honoured by this endpoint, so callers should not attempt to update system configuration and process an instruction relying upon it immediately after.

This endpoint also supports [ISO 20022](https://www.iso20022.org/) XML messages as the body of the request.

When using ISO 20022 XML messages, the caller should ensure to set the HTTP header `Content-Type: application/xml`, in addition to the following headers with values corresponding to their JSON counterparts: `X-Tm-Request-Id` (`request_id`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Correlation-Id` (`instruction.correlation_id`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Payment-Id` (`instruction.payment_id`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Flow-Id` (`instruction.instruction_flow_id`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Payment-System` (`instruction.payment_system`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Scheme` (`instruction.scheme`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Direction` (`instruction.direction`).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.instructions:write, payments.instructions:initiate

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/instructions:initiate

#### [](#_payments_v1_instruction_Instruction_ProcessInstruction "Copy link to heading")Process

Processes an Instruction synchronously, returning the final state of the Instruction once processing completes. This endpoint should only be used if the caller requires the result of processing immediately, and is only suitable for instructions which can be processed within the duration of a request. An error may be returned if processing fails or does not complete within the request timeout. The caller may retry the request to obtain the result of processing, but is not required to do so. Processing will continue in the background regardless. The final result of processing is also made available on the Instructions event stream. Configuration properties may take a short amount of time to be honoured by this endpoint, so callers should not attempt to update system configuration and process an instruction relying upon it immediately after.

This endpoint also supports [ISO 20022](https://www.iso20022.org/) XML messages as the body of the request and response.

When using ISO 20022 XML messages, the caller should ensure to set the HTTP header `Content-Type: application/xml`, in addition to the following headers with values corresponding to their JSON counterparts: `X-Tm-Request-Id` (`request_id`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Correlation-Id` (`instruction.correlation_id`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Payment-Id` (`instruction.payment_id`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Flow-Id` (`instruction.instruction_flow_id`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Payment-System` (`instruction.payment_system`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Scheme` (`instruction.scheme`), `X-Tm-Instruction-Direction` (`instruction.direction`).

The caller can determine the response type by providing the HTTP header `Accept: application/json` or `Accept: application/xml`. If not provided, the value of the `Content-Type` header will be used as a default.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.instructions:write, payments.instructions:process

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/instructions:process
