The type is a reversal initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CARD\_MANAGEMENT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card management initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RESOLUTION\_OF\_INVESTIGATION:**  
The type represents a resolution of investigation response, indicating acceptance or rejection of a previous request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_PAYMENT\_RETURN:**  
The type represents a payment return, used for returning a previously received credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_ADMINISTRATIVE\_INITIATION:**  
The type is an administrative initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer credit transfer initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_DIRECT\_DEBIT:**  
The type is used to collect funds from a debtor account for a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_DIRECT\_DEBIT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer direct debit initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RECEIPT\_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:**  
The type is a receipt acknowledgement.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INSTITUTION\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is a financial institution credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_INITIATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate initiation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_AMENDMENT\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate amendment request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_ACCEPTANCE\_REPORT:**  
The type is mandate acceptance report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_DEBIT\_CREDIT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer Debit and Credit Notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FILE\_ACTION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is file action initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FRAUD\_DISPOSITION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is fraud disposition initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a customer payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MESSAGE\_REJECT:**  
The type is a message reject.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is an investigation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_RESPONSE:**  
The type is an investigation response.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_ACCOUNT\_REPORT:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer account report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_SYSTEM\_EVENT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a system event notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CLAIM\_NON\_RECEIPT:**  
The type is a claim non receipt.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REQUEST\_TO\_MODIFY\_PAYMENT:**  
The type is a request to modify payment.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_REVERSAL:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment reversal.  
  
**Default**  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

**direction**  
  
enum

 | 

The direction of the Instruction. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_DIRECTION\_UNKNOWN:**  
The Instruction direction is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_DIRECTION\_INBOUND:**  
The Instruction direction is inbound.  
**INSTRUCTION\_DIRECTION\_OUTBOUND:**  
The Instruction direction is outbound.

 |
| 

**processing\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The processing status of the Instruction.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The processing status is unknown.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Instruction processing has completed.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
An error has occurred during the processing of the Instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**  
Instruction processing is waiting for an event to continue.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
Instruction processing is queued behind a currently processing matched instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**  
Instruction has been interrupted by another instruction and its processing has been suspended until the interrupting instruction completes processing.

 |
| 

**processing\_mode**  
  
enum

 | 

Defines the processing mode for the Instruction. Derived from the assigned Instruction Flow Version. Output only.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_MODE\_QUEUE:**  
Instruction will be queued behind any incomplete matched instructions. Default behaviour.  
**PROCESSING\_MODE\_INTERRUPT:**  
Instruction will interrupt previous WAITING matched instruction if present.

 |
| 

**processing\_error**  
  
object

 | 

Details on an error that occurred during the processing of the Instruction. Set when `processing_status` has value `PROCESSING_STATUS_ERRORED`.

 |
| 

processing\_error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

processing\_error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

 |
| 

processing\_error.  
**details\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

An optional list of messages that carry the error details.

 |

**OUTCOME\_UNKNOWN:**  
Outcome of the instruction is unknown.  
**OUTCOME\_PENDING:**

**OUTCOME\_ACCEPTED:**

**OUTCOME\_REJECTED:**

**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of Instruction message. Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
The type is unknown.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_AUTHORISATION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card authorisation initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INQUIRY\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card (balance)inquiry initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is used to move funds from a debtor account to a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card financial initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REVERSAL\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a reversal initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CARD\_MANAGEMENT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a card management initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment status request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RESOLUTION\_OF\_INVESTIGATION:**  
The type represents a resolution of investigation response, indicating acceptance or rejection of a previous request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_PAYMENT\_RETURN:**  
The type represents a payment return, used for returning a previously received credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_ADMINISTRATIVE\_INITIATION:**  
The type is an administrative initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer credit transfer initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_DIRECT\_DEBIT:**  
The type is used to collect funds from a debtor account for a creditor.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_DIRECT\_DEBIT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer direct debit initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RECEIPT\_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:**  
The type is a receipt acknowledgement.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INSTITUTION\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is a financial institution credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_INITIATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate initiation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_AMENDMENT\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate amendment request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_ACCEPTANCE\_REPORT:**  
The type is mandate acceptance report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_DEBIT\_CREDIT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer Debit and Credit Notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FILE\_ACTION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is file action initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FRAUD\_DISPOSITION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is fraud disposition initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a customer payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MESSAGE\_REJECT:**  
The type is a message reject.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is an investigation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_RESPONSE:**  
The type is an investigation response.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_ACCOUNT\_REPORT:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer account report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_SYSTEM\_EVENT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a system event notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CLAIM\_NON\_RECEIPT:**  
The type is a claim non receipt.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_REQUEST\_TO\_MODIFY\_PAYMENT:**  
The type is a request to modify payment.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_PAYMENT\_REVERSAL:**  
The type represents a Financial Institution-to-Financial Institution (FI to FI) payment reversal.

-   [Callback](#_payments_v1_integrations_CallbackResponse_Callback) Resumes processing of Instruction awaiting specific callback from an aynchronous Integration.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_integrations_CallbackResponse_Callback "Copy link to heading")Callback

Resumes processing of Instruction awaiting specific callback from an aynchronous Integration. The token is generated in the `HTTPAsync` step, is unique and should be used only once.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.integrations:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/integrations:callback/{token}

### [](#integration "Copy link to heading")Integration

#### [](#available_methods_37 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_integrations_ListIntegrationsResponse_ListIntegrations) Lists and filters Integrations.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_integrations_Integration_CreateIntegration) Creates an Integration.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_integrations_Integration_GetIntegration) Retrieves a single Integration by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_integrations_Integration_UpdateIntegration) Updates an Integration.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_integrations_BatchGetIntegrationsResponse_BatchGetIntegrations) Retrieves one or more Integrations by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_integrations_ListIntegrationsResponse_ListIntegrations "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters Integrations. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.integrations:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/integrations

##### [](#request_113 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned. Optional.

 |
| 

**types**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The integration types to filter for.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INTEGRATION\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default integration type value.  
**INTEGRATION\_TYPE\_VAULT\_CORE\_POSTINGS:**  
Vault Core Postings integration type.  
**INTEGRATION\_TYPE\_HTTP:**  
Generic HTTP integration type.  
**INTEGRATION\_TYPE\_HTTP\_ASYNC:**  
Generic HTTP Async integration type.  
**INTEGRATION\_TYPE\_SCHEME\_SUBMISSION:**  
Scheme Submission integration type.  
**INTEGRATION\_TYPE\_SWIFT\_AGI:**  
SWIFT Alliance Gateway Instant (AGI) integration type.  
**INTEGRATION\_TYPE\_FEDLINE:**  
Fedline integration type.

 |
| 

**fields\_to\_include**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The fields to include when retrieving the list of Integrations. Only if present here will the field be included in the response.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INCLUDE\_FIELD\_ACTIVE\_VERSION:**  
Include the active IntegrationVersion.

 |

integrations\[\].

**error**  
  
object

 | 

Error when creating the integration verion.

 |
| 

integrations\[\].  
active\_version.  
error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

integrations\[\].  
active\_version.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

 |

**INVALID\_VALUE:**

**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

active\_version.  
**error**  
  
object

 | 

Error when creating the integration verion.

 |
| 

active\_version.  
error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

active\_version.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

object

 | 

Error when creating the integration verion.

active\_version.  
error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

active\_version.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_integrations_Integration_UpdateIntegration "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates an Integration. Fields allowed for update are display\_name and description.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.integrations:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/integrations/{integration.id}

active\_version.  
**error**  
  
object

 | 

Error when creating the integration verion.

active\_version.  
error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

active\_version.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_integrations_BatchGetIntegrationsResponse_BatchGetIntegrations "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves one or more Integrations by ID. A `NOT_FOUND` API error will be returned if any of the requested resources can not be found.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.integrations:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/integrations:batchGet

##### [](#request_117 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the Integrations to be retrieved.  
  
Required.  
Min length: 1 characters.  
Max length: 100 characters.

 |
| 

**fields\_to\_include**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The fields to include when retrieving the Integrations. Only if present here will the field be included in the response.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INCLUDE\_FIELD\_ACTIVE\_VERSION:**  
Include the active IntegrationVersion.

By default the token is sent in the `Authorization` HTTP header using the Bearer authentication scheme, i.e. as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. `custom_header` allows overriding this behaviour. The contents of this field will be obfuscated as `*****` in all responses.  
  
Required.

**error**  
  
object

 | 

Error when creating the integration verion.

 |
| 

integrations\[KEY\].  
active\_version.  
error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

integrations\[KEY\].  
active\_version.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

### [](#integrationversion "Copy link to heading")IntegrationVersion

#### [](#available_methods_38 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_integrations_ListIntegrationVersionsResponse_ListIntegrationVersions) Lists and filters IntegrationVersions.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_integrations_IntegrationVersion_CreateIntegrationVersion) Creates an IntegrationVersion.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_integrations_IntegrationVersion_GetIntegrationVersion) Retrieves a single IntegrationVersion by ID.
    
-   [Retry](#_payments_v1_integrations_RetryIntegrationVersionResponse_RetryIntegrationVersion) Allows retrying of an Integration Version which has failed to be provisioned with a status of `STATUS_ERRORED`.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_integrations_BatchGetIntegrationVersionsResponse_BatchGetIntegrationVersions) Retrieves one or more IntegrationVersions by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_integrations_ListIntegrationVersionsResponse_ListIntegrationVersions "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters IntegrationVersions. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.integration\_versions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/integration-versions

##### [](#request_118 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The number of results to be listed.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are to be retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned. Optional.

 |
| 

**integration\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Integration IDs to filter for.

 |
| 

**statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

Statuses to filter for. Defaults to all statuses.  
  
**Enum values**  
**STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default status value.  
**STATUS\_PENDING:**  
Background processes needed to set up the integration are underway.  
**STATUS\_READY:**  
Integration is ready.  
**STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
Integration is in a non-viable state.  
**STATUS\_USER\_ACTION\_REQUIRED:**  
Integration cannot become available until the client performs some action (e.g accepting an incoming PrivateLink endpoint connection).  
**STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
Integration has been explicitly marked as disabled and cannot be used anymore.

integration\_versions\[\].  
**error**  
  
object

 | 

Error when creating the integration verion.

integration\_versions\[\].  
error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

integration\_versions\[\].  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

**error**  
  
object

 | 

Error when creating the integration verion.

 |
| 

error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

 |
| 

error.  
**details\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

An optional list of messages that carry the error details.

**error**  
  
object

 | 

Error when creating the integration verion.

 |
| 

error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

 |
| 

error.  
**details\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

An optional list of messages that carry the error details.

object

#### [](#_payments_v1_integrations_RetryIntegrationVersionResponse_RetryIntegrationVersion "Copy link to heading")Retry

Allows retrying of an Integration Version which has failed to be provisioned with a status of `STATUS_ERRORED`. This will move the Integration Version back to `STATUS_PENDING` and cause provisioning to be retried asynchronously.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.integration\_versions:write, payments.integration\_versions:retry

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/integration-versions/{id}:retry

##### [](#request_121 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**id**  
  
string

 | 

ID of the IntegrationVersion to be retried.

 |

**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

#### [](#_payments_v1_integrations_BatchGetIntegrationVersionsResponse_BatchGetIntegrationVersions "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves one or more IntegrationVersions by ID. A `NOT_FOUND` API error will be returned if any of the requested resources can not be found.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.integration\_versions:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/integration-versions:batchGet

##### [](#request_122 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the IntegrationVersions to be retrieved.  
This field must contain a valid UUID in the canonical 8-4-4-4-12 form.  
Required.  
Min length: 1 characters.  
Max length: 100 characters.

object

integration\_versions\[KEY\].

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

integration\_versions\[KEY\].  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

## [](#mandates "Copy link to heading")Mandates

### [](#mandate "Copy link to heading")Mandate

#### [](#available_methods_39 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_mandates_ListMandatesResponse_ListMandates2) Lists and filters Mandates.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_mandates_Mandate_GetMandate2) Retrieves the Mandate with the specified ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_mandates_BatchGetMandatesResponse_BatchGetMandates) Retrieves the Mandate with the specified ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_mandates_ListMandatesResponse_ListMandates2 "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters Mandates. By default, results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.mandates:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoints:** GET /api/v1/mandates, GET /api/v1beta/mandates

##### [](#request_123 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned. Optional.

 |

## [](#manual_decisions "Copy link to heading")Manual Decisions

### [](#manualdecision "Copy link to heading")ManualDecision

#### [](#available_methods_40 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_manualdecisions_ListManualDecisionsResponse_ListManualDecisions) Lists and filters ManualDecisions.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_manualdecisions_ManualDecision_GetManualDecision) Retrieves a ManualDecision by ID.
    
-   [Submit](#_payments_v1_manualdecisions_ManualDecision_SubmitManualDecision) Submits a ManualDecision.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_manualdecisions_BatchGetManualDecisionsResponse_BatchGetManualDecisions) Retrieves one or more ManualDecisions by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_manualdecisions_ListManualDecisionsResponse_ListManualDecisions "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters ManualDecisions. By default, results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.manual\_decisions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/manual-decisions

##### [](#request_126 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned. Optional.

 |
| 

**instruction\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The ManualDecision Instruction IDs to filter by. Optional.

 |
| 

**statuses**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The ManualDecision statuses to filter by. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**MANUAL\_DECISION\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Unknown  
**MANUAL\_DECISION\_STATUS\_PENDING:**  
The ManualDecision is pending initialisation.  
**MANUAL\_DECISION\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The ManualDecision is queued.  
**MANUAL\_DECISION\_STATUS\_SUBMITTING:**  
The ManualDecision is in the process of being submitted.  
**MANUAL\_DECISION\_STATUS\_SUBMITTED:**  
The ManualDecision was successfully submitted.  
**MANUAL\_DECISION\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The ManualDecision has expired.  
**MANUAL\_DECISION\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The ManualDecision has errored.

 |

## [](#membership_directories "Copy link to heading")Membership Directories

The Membership Directories API allows membership directory files to be uploaded, so that instruction flows may query their underlying records.

For more information, see the [Membership Directories conecpts section](/vault-payments/latest/EN/using_vault_payments/membership_directories).

### [](#membershipdirectory "Copy link to heading")MembershipDirectory

#### [](#available_methods_41 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_ListMembershipDirectoriesResponse_ListMembershipDirectories) Lists and filters MembershipDirectories.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_MembershipDirectory_CreateMembershipDirectory) Creates an MembershipDirectory.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_MembershipDirectory_GetMembershipDirectory) Retrieves a single MembershipDirectory by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_MembershipDirectory_UpdateMembershipDirectory) Updates an MembershipDirectory.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_BatchGetMembershipDirectoriesResponse_BatchGetMembershipDirectories) Retrieves one or more MembershipDirectories by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_ListMembershipDirectoriesResponse_ListMembershipDirectories "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters MembershipDirectories. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.membership\_directories:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/membership-directories

##### [](#request_130 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned. Optional.

 |
| 

**types**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The membership directory types to filter for.  
  
**Enum values**  
**MEMBERSHIP\_DIRECTORY\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default membership directory type value.  
**MEMBERSHIP\_DIRECTORY\_TYPE\_TIPS:**  
TIPS membership directory type.  
**MEMBERSHIP\_DIRECTORY\_TYPE\_FEDWIRE:**  
Fedwire membership directory type.  
**MEMBERSHIP\_DIRECTORY\_TYPE\_FEDACH:**  
FedACH membership directory type.  
**MEMBERSHIP\_DIRECTORY\_TYPE\_BACS:**  
BACS membership directory type.  
**MEMBERSHIP\_DIRECTORY\_TYPE\_FPS:**  
FPS membership directory type.

### [](#membershipdirectoryrecord "Copy link to heading")MembershipDirectoryRecord

#### [](#available_methods_42 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Search](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_SearchMembershipDirectoryRecordsResponse_SearchMembershipDirectoryRecords) Retrieves one or more MembershipDirectoryRecords by member ID and directory ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_SearchMembershipDirectoryRecordsResponse_SearchMembershipDirectoryRecords "Copy link to heading")Search

Retrieves one or more MembershipDirectoryRecords by member ID and directory ID. For each directory ID, the records from the latest READY version are returned.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.membership\_directory\_records:read

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/membership-directory-records:search

##### [](#request_135 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**member\_ids\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the directory members to lookup in the MembershipDirectoryVersion. Varies by the membership directory type:  
  
\- TIPS: User BIC  
\- Fedwire: Routing Number  
\- FedACH: Routing Number  
\- BACS: Sort Code  
\- FPS: Sort Code

 |
| 

**membership\_directory\_ids\[\]**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the MembershipDirectory resources to lookup.

 |

#### [](#_payments_v1_membershipdirectories_ListMembershipDirectoryVersionsResponse_ListMembershipDirectoryVersions "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters MembershipDirectoryVersions. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.membership\_directory\_versions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/membership-directory-versions

enum

**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_parameters_ListParametersResponse_ListParameters "Copy link to heading")List

Lists Parameters. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.parameters:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/parameters

### [](#parametervalue "Copy link to heading")ParameterValue

#### [](#available_methods_45 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_parameters_ListParameterValuesResponse_ListParameterValues) Lists and filters ParameterValues.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_parameters_ParameterValue_CreateParameterValue) Creates a ParameterValue.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_parameters_ParameterValue_GetParameterValue) Retrieves a single ParameterValue by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_parameters_ParameterValue_UpdateParameterValue) Updates a Parameter Value.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_parameters_BatchGetParameterValuesResponse_BatchGetParameterValues) Retrieves one or more ParameterValues by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_parameters_ListParameterValuesResponse_ListParameterValues "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters ParameterValues. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.parameter\_values:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/parameter-values

##### [](#request_145 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

## [](#payees "Copy link to heading")Payees

### [](#payee "Copy link to heading")Payee

#### [](#available_methods_46 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Create](#_payments_v1_payees_Payee_CreatePayee) Creates a Payee.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_payees_Payee_GetPayee) Retrieves a Payee by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_payees_Payee_UpdatePayee) Updates a Payee.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_payees_BatchGetPayeesResponse_BatchGetPayees) Retrieves one or more Payees by ID.
    
-   [Search](#_payments_v1_payees_SearchPayeesResponse_SearchPayees) Lists and filters Payees.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_payees_Payee_CreatePayee "Copy link to heading")Create

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/payees

#### [](#_payments_v1_payees_SearchPayeesResponse_SearchPayees "Copy link to heading")Search

Lists and filters Payees. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.payees:read

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/payees:search

##### [](#request_154 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**owner\_type**  
  
enum

 | 

The payee’s owner type to filter by.  
  
Required.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYEE\_OWNER\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Unspecified payee owner type.  
**PAYEE\_OWNER\_TYPE\_PAYMENT\_INSTRUMENT:**  
This indicates the payee is owned by a payment instrument.  
**PAYEE\_OWNER\_TYPE\_ACCOUNT\_LINK:**  
This indicates the payee is owned by an account link.  
**PAYEE\_OWNER\_TYPE\_OTHER:**  
Generic owner type.  
  
**Default**  
**PAYEE\_OWNER\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

 |
| 

**owner\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The payee’s owner resource ID to filter by.  
  
Required.

 |
| 

**routing\_information**  
  
object

 | 

The payee’s routing information to filter by. Requires an exact match on the values.

 |
| 

routing\_information.  
**instrument\_identifier**  
  
string

 | 

The identifier of the individual instrument within the institution, such as IBAN, Account Number, Card ID. Required on creation.

 |
| 

routing\_information.  
**bank\_identifier**  
  
string

 | 

The identifier of the institution to which the instrument belongs, such as BIC, UK Sort Code.

 |
| 

**statuses\[\]**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The Payee statuses to filter by. Defaults to \["PAYEE\_STATUS\_ACTIVE"\].  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYEE\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Unknown payee status.  
**PAYEE\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The payee is active.  
**PAYEE\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The payee is inactive.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
long

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

## [](#payments "Copy link to heading")Payments

### [](#payment_2 "Copy link to heading")Payment

#### [](#available_methods_47 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Get](#_payments_v1_payments_Payment_GetPayment) Retrieves a Payment with the specified ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_payments_BatchGetPaymentsResponse_BatchGetPayments) Retrieves Payments with the specified IDs.
    
-   [Search](#_payments_v1_payments_SearchPaymentsResponse_SearchPayments) Retrieves Payments based on the provided search query.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_payments_Payment_GetPayment "Copy link to heading")Get

Retrieves a Payment with the specified ID.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.payments:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/payments/{id}

##### [](#request_155 "Copy link to heading")Request

Path parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Payment to retrieve

 |

##### [](#responses_155 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**id**  
  
string

 | 

The unique identifier of the payment. It is taken from the payment\_id field of the constituent instructions.

 |
| 

**create\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time that the resource was created. UTC, RFC3339 Format. Output only.

 |
| 

**update\_timestamp**  
  
dateTime

 | 

The time that the resource was last updated. UTC, RFC3339 Format. Output only.

 |
| 

**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of the Payment.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Next: 22  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_UNSUPPORTED:**  
If set the Payment type is currently not support by Vault Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
A credit transfer Payment.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_FEE\_COLLECTION:**  
A fee collection Payment.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_CARD:**  
A card Payment.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_WALLET:**  
A wallet Payment.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_ACCOUNT\_TRANSFER:**  
An account transfer.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_ADMIN:**  
An admin payment.

 |
| 

**channel**  
  
enum

 | 

The channel of the Payment indicates the channel it was initiated from. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CHANNEL\_UNKNOWN:**  
The payment channel is not set.  
**CHANNEL\_POS:**  
The payment was initiated from a POS.  
**CHANNEL\_ATM:**  
The payment was initiated from an ATM.  
**CHANNEL\_IN\_APP:**  
The payment was initiated from within the app.  
**CHANNEL\_MERCHANT:**  
The payment was initiated by the merchant.  
**CHANNEL\_P2P:**  
The payment was initiated peer-to-peer.

 |
| 

**action**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of action that the Payment represents.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACTION\_UNKNOWN:**  
The payment action type is not set.  
**ACTION\_FINANCIAL:**  
The payment has financial impact.  
**ACTION\_INQUIRY:**  
The payment is facilitating an inquiry  
**ACTION\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The payment is transmitting a notification.  
**ACTION\_MANAGEMENT:**  
The payment is facilitating a management action.

 |
| 

**reason**  
  
enum

 | 

The reason for which the Payment was initiated. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**REASON\_UNKNOWN:**  
The payment reason is not set.  
**REASON\_PURCHASE:**  
The reason for the payment is making a purchase  
**REASON\_REFUND:**  
The reason for the payment is processing a refund  
**REASON\_CHARGEBACK:**  
The reason for the payment is processing a chargeback  
**REASON\_REPRESENTMENT:**  
The reason for the payment is processing a representment  
**REASON\_FEE:**  
The reason for the payment is processing a fee

 |
| 

**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the payment.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The default value which should not occur. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PROCESSING:**  
The Payment is processing. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Payment is in an errored state. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_AUTHORISED:**  
The Payment has been authorised. Relevant for card and credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_AUTHORISATION\_REJECTED:**  
The Payment’s authorisation was rejected. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PARTIALLY\_CLEARED:**  
The Payment has been partially cleared. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_CLEARED:**  
The Payment has been cleared. Relevant for card Payments and standalone fee collections.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REVERSED:**  
The Payment has been reversed. Relevant for card Payments and standalone fee collections.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_EXPIRED:**  
The Payment has expired. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Payment was rejected. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RECEIVED:**  
An instruction was received from the scheme. Relevant for cards stand-in and credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_INITIATED:**  
The Payment has been initiated. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The Payment was cancelled. This is either by an operator within this financial institution for any Payment type, or by a party involved in the Payment for credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_SETTLED:**  
The Payment has been settled. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGED:**  
The PIN was changed. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGE\_REJECTED:**  
The PIN change was rejected. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGE\_REVERSED:**  
The PIN change was reversed. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCKED:**  
The PIN was unblocked. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCK\_REJECTED:**  
The PIN unblock request was rejected. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCK\_REVERSED:**  
The PIN unblock request was reversed. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RETURNED:**  
The Payment was returned. Relevant for credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_SCHEDULED:**  
The Payment was scheduled. Relevant for cards stand-in and credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_ACCEPTED:**  
The Payment was accepted. Relevant for cards advice and zero-amount Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RECALL\_REQUESTED:**  
A recall has been requested for this payment. The payment was previously settled, and a formal process to retrieve the funds has been initiated, but the outcome is not yet known.

 |

instruction\_data\[\].  
**processing\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `processing_status`  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The processing status is unknown.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Instruction processing has completed.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
An error has occurred during the processing of the Instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**  
Instruction processing is waiting for an event to continue.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
Instruction processing is queued behind a currently processing matched instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**  
Instruction has been interrupted by another instruction and its processing has been suspended until the interrupting instruction completes processing.

 |
| 

instruction\_data\[\].  
**processing\_error\_code**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `processing_error_code`  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

**OUTCOME\_ACCEPTED:**

**OUTCOME\_REJECTED:**

instruction\_data\[\].  
file\_action\_initiation.  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `file_action_initiation.message_v03.data_record.text`  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

**MESSAGE\_FUNCTION\_CAPTURE\_ADVICE:**

**MESSAGE\_FUNCTION\_REQUEST:**

**MESSAGE\_FUNCTION\_ACQUIRER\_REVERSAL\_REQUEST:**

**MESSAGE\_FUNCTION\_REVERSAL\_NOTIFICATION:**

instruction\_data\[\].  
card\_management\_initiation.  
**card\_data\_entry\_mode**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `card_management_initiation.message.body.context.point_of_service_context.card_data_entry_mode`  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_UNKNOWN:**  
The card data reading capabilities are unknown.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_PROXIMITY:**  
ICC contactless proximity.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MAGNETIC\_STRIPE:**  
Magnetic stripe.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_CONTACT:**  
ICC contact capability.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MAGNETIC\_INK\_CHARACTER\_RECOGNITION:**  
Recognition of magnetic ink characters.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MANUAL\_ENTRY:**  
Manual, no terminal used.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OPTICAL\_CHARACTER\_RECOGNITION:**  
OCR either at time of transaction or after the event.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MSI\_PROXIMITY:**  
Magstripe image contactless proximity.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OPTICAL\_CODE:**  
Optical coded reading capabilities (e.g. barcode, QR code, etc.).  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OTHER\_NATIONAL:**  
Other national capability type assigned at national level.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_RFID\_TAG:**  
Radio Frequency Identification tag capabilities.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_UNSPECIFIED:**  
Unspecified capability.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OTHER\_PRIVATE:**  
Other card reading capability assigned on a private basis.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_KEY\_ENTERED:**  
Key entered.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_CARD\_ON\_FILE:**  
Card information is stored on file.

#### [](#_payments_v1_payments_BatchGetPaymentsResponse_BatchGetPayments "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves Payments with the specified IDs.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.payments:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/payments:batchGet

##### [](#request_156 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The IDs of the payments to be retrieved.  
  
Required.  
Min count: 1.  
Max count: 100.

 |

Success Errors

map \[string: object\]

 | 

The Payments that match the requested IDs.

string

 | 

The unique identifier of the payment. It is taken from the payment\_id field of the constituent instructions.

enum

 | 

The type of the Payment.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Next: 22  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_UNSUPPORTED:**  
If set the Payment type is currently not support by Vault Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
A credit transfer Payment.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_FEE\_COLLECTION:**  
A fee collection Payment.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_CARD:**  
A card Payment.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_WALLET:**  
A wallet Payment.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_ACCOUNT\_TRANSFER:**  
An account transfer.  
**PAYMENT\_TYPE\_ADMIN:**  
An admin payment.

 |
| 

payments\[KEY\].  
**channel**  
  
enum

 | 

The channel of the Payment indicates the channel it was initiated from. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CHANNEL\_UNKNOWN:**  
The payment channel is not set.  
**CHANNEL\_POS:**  
The payment was initiated from a POS.  
**CHANNEL\_ATM:**  
The payment was initiated from an ATM.  
**CHANNEL\_IN\_APP:**  
The payment was initiated from within the app.  
**CHANNEL\_MERCHANT:**  
The payment was initiated by the merchant.  
**CHANNEL\_P2P:**  
The payment was initiated peer-to-peer.

 |
| 

payments\[KEY\].  
**action**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of action that the Payment represents.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACTION\_UNKNOWN:**  
The payment action type is not set.  
**ACTION\_FINANCIAL:**  
The payment has financial impact.  
**ACTION\_INQUIRY:**  
The payment is facilitating an inquiry  
**ACTION\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The payment is transmitting a notification.  
**ACTION\_MANAGEMENT:**  
The payment is facilitating a management action.

 |
| 

payments\[KEY\].  
**reason**  
  
enum

 | 

The reason for which the Payment was initiated. Optional.  
  
**Enum values**  
**REASON\_UNKNOWN:**  
The payment reason is not set.  
**REASON\_PURCHASE:**  
The reason for the payment is making a purchase  
**REASON\_REFUND:**  
The reason for the payment is processing a refund  
**REASON\_CHARGEBACK:**  
The reason for the payment is processing a chargeback  
**REASON\_REPRESENTMENT:**  
The reason for the payment is processing a representment  
**REASON\_FEE:**  
The reason for the payment is processing a fee

 |
| 

payments\[KEY\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the payment.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The default value which should not occur. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PROCESSING:**  
The Payment is processing. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Payment is in an errored state. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_AUTHORISED:**  
The Payment has been authorised. Relevant for card and credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_AUTHORISATION\_REJECTED:**  
The Payment’s authorisation was rejected. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PARTIALLY\_CLEARED:**  
The Payment has been partially cleared. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_CLEARED:**  
The Payment has been cleared. Relevant for card Payments and standalone fee collections.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REVERSED:**  
The Payment has been reversed. Relevant for card Payments and standalone fee collections.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_EXPIRED:**  
The Payment has expired. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Payment was rejected. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RECEIVED:**  
An instruction was received from the scheme. Relevant for cards stand-in and credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_INITIATED:**  
The Payment has been initiated. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The Payment was cancelled. This is either by an operator within this financial institution for any Payment type, or by a party involved in the Payment for credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_SETTLED:**  
The Payment has been settled. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGED:**  
The PIN was changed. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGE\_REJECTED:**  
The PIN change was rejected. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGE\_REVERSED:**  
The PIN change was reversed. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCKED:**  
The PIN was unblocked. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCK\_REJECTED:**  
The PIN unblock request was rejected. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCK\_REVERSED:**  
The PIN unblock request was reversed. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RETURNED:**  
The Payment was returned. Relevant for credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_SCHEDULED:**  
The Payment was scheduled. Relevant for cards stand-in and credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_ACCEPTED:**  
The Payment was accepted. Relevant for cards advice and zero-amount Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RECALL\_REQUESTED:**  
A recall has been requested for this payment. The payment was previously settled, and a formal process to retrieve the funds has been initiated, but the outcome is not yet known.

payments\[KEY\].

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `processing_status`  
  
**Enum values**  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The processing status is unknown.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
Instruction processing has completed.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
An error has occurred during the processing of the Instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**  
Instruction processing is waiting for an event to continue.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
Instruction processing is queued behind a currently processing matched instruction.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**  
Instruction has been interrupted by another instruction and its processing has been suspended until the interrupting instruction completes processing.

 |
| 

payments\[KEY\].  
instruction\_data\[\].  
**processing\_error\_code**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `processing_error_code`  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_PAYMENT\_RETURN:**

**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_ADMINISTRATIVE\_INITIATION:**  
The type is an administrative initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer credit transfer initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_DIRECT\_DEBIT:**

**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_DIRECT\_DEBIT\_INITIATION:**  
The type is a customer direct debit initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_RECEIPT\_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT:**  
The type is a receipt acknowledgement.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FINANCIAL\_INSTITUTION\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER:**  
The type is a financial institution credit transfer.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_INITIATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate initiation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_AMENDMENT\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate amendment request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_CANCELLATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is mandate cancellation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MANDATE\_ACCEPTANCE\_REPORT:**  
The type is mandate acceptance report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_DEBIT\_CREDIT\_NOTIFICATION:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer Debit and Credit Notification.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FILE\_ACTION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is file action initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FRAUD\_DISPOSITION\_INITIATION:**  
The type is fraud disposition initiation.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CREDITOR\_PAYMENT\_ACTIVATION\_REQUEST\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a creditor payment activation request status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CUSTOMER\_PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REPORT:**  
The type is a customer payment status report.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_MESSAGE\_REJECT:**  
The type is a message reject.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_REQUEST:**  
The type is an investigation request.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_INVESTIGATION\_RESPONSE:**  
The type is an investigation response.  
**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_BANK\_TO\_CUSTOMER\_ACCOUNT\_REPORT:**  
The type is a Bank-to-Customer account report.

**INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_CLAIM\_NON\_RECEIPT:**

The type is a request to modify payment.
