payments\[KEY\].  
instruction\_data\[\].  
file\_action\_initiation.  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `file_action_initiation.message_v03.data_record.text`  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

payments\[KEY\].

card\_management\_initiation.  
**card\_data\_entry\_mode**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `card_management_initiation.message.body.context.point_of_service_context.card_data_entry_mode`  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_UNKNOWN:**  
The card data reading capabilities are unknown.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_PROXIMITY:**  
ICC contactless proximity.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MAGNETIC\_STRIPE:**  
Magnetic stripe.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_CONTACT:**  
ICC contact capability.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MAGNETIC\_INK\_CHARACTER\_RECOGNITION:**  
Recognition of magnetic ink characters.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MANUAL\_ENTRY:**  
Manual, no terminal used.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OPTICAL\_CHARACTER\_RECOGNITION:**  
OCR either at time of transaction or after the event.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MSI\_PROXIMITY:**  
Magstripe image contactless proximity.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OPTICAL\_CODE:**  
Optical coded reading capabilities (e.g. barcode, QR code, etc.).  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OTHER\_NATIONAL:**  
Other national capability type assigned at national level.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_RFID\_TAG:**  
Radio Frequency Identification tag capabilities.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_UNSPECIFIED:**  
Unspecified capability.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OTHER\_PRIVATE:**  
Other card reading capability assigned on a private basis.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_KEY\_ENTERED:**  
Key entered.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_CARD\_ON\_FILE:**  
Card information is stored on file.

Field is not a valid format e.g. email address, UUID, IP Address, URI etc.  
**INVALID\_VALUE:**  
Indicates that a provided field is not equal to one of the specified values.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

#### [](#_payments_v1_payments_SearchPaymentsResponse_SearchPayments "Copy link to heading")Search

Retrieves Payments based on the provided search query.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.payments:read

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/payments:search

##### [](#request_157 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**query**  
  
string

 | 

A search query written in the Vault Payments Search Query Language. Documentation for the language can be found on the "Search Query Language" page.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
long

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page to retrieve. Optional. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

payments\[\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the payment.  
  
**Enum values**  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The default value which should not occur. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PROCESSING:**  
The Payment is processing. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Payment is in an errored state. Relevant for all Payment types.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_AUTHORISED:**  
The Payment has been authorised. Relevant for card and credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_AUTHORISATION\_REJECTED:**  
The Payment’s authorisation was rejected. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PARTIALLY\_CLEARED:**  
The Payment has been partially cleared. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_CLEARED:**  
The Payment has been cleared. Relevant for card Payments and standalone fee collections.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REVERSED:**  
The Payment has been reversed. Relevant for card Payments and standalone fee collections.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_EXPIRED:**  
The Payment has expired. Relevant for card Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Payment was rejected. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RECEIVED:**  
An instruction was received from the scheme. Relevant for cards stand-in and credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_INITIATED:**  
The Payment has been initiated. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
The Payment was cancelled. This is either by an operator within this financial institution for any Payment type, or by a party involved in the Payment for credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_SETTLED:**  
The Payment has been settled. Relevant for credit transfer Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGED:**  
The PIN was changed. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGE\_REJECTED:**  
The PIN change was rejected. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_CHANGE\_REVERSED:**  
The PIN change was reversed. Relevant for PIN change Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCKED:**  
The PIN was unblocked. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCK\_REJECTED:**  
The PIN unblock request was rejected. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_PIN\_UNBLOCK\_REVERSED:**  
The PIN unblock request was reversed. Relevant for PIN unblock Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RETURNED:**  
The Payment was returned. Relevant for credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_SCHEDULED:**  
The Payment was scheduled. Relevant for cards stand-in and credit transfers.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_ACCEPTED:**  
The Payment was accepted. Relevant for cards advice and zero-amount Payments.  
**PAYMENT\_STATUS\_RECALL\_REQUESTED:**  
A recall has been requested for this payment. The payment was previously settled, and a formal process to retrieve the funds has been initiated, but the outcome is not yet known.

enum

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
Instruction processing is in progress.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_CANCELLED:**  
Instruction processing has been cancelled.  
**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_WAITING:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**

**PROCESSING\_STATUS\_INTERRUPTED:**

 |
| 

payments\[\].  
instruction\_data\[\].  
**processing\_error\_code**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `processing_error_code`  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

payments\[\].  
instruction\_data\[\].  
file\_action\_initiation.  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

this is populated from the Instruction field `file_action_initiation.message_v03.data_record.text`  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default value.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_PENDING\_CREATION:**  
An intermediate Card status during creation.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been created but not yet activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been fully activated.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_ACTIVE:**  
The status of a Card that has been activated only for online and tokenised transacting.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been suspended.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DIGITALLY\_SUSPENDED:**  
A non-terminal status of a Card that has been digitally suspended, this state indicates the card was previously in `CARD_STATUS_DIGITALLY_ACTIVE`.  
**CARD\_STATUS\_DISABLED:**  
A terminal status of a Card that has been disabled.

**Enum values**  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_UNKNOWN:**  
The card data reading capabilities are unknown.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_PROXIMITY:**  
ICC contactless proximity.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MAGNETIC\_STRIPE:**  
Magnetic stripe.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_CONTACT:**  
ICC contact capability.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MAGNETIC\_INK\_CHARACTER\_RECOGNITION:**  
Recognition of magnetic ink characters.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MANUAL\_ENTRY:**  
Manual, no terminal used.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OPTICAL\_CHARACTER\_RECOGNITION:**  
OCR either at time of transaction or after the event.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MSI\_PROXIMITY:**  
Magstripe image contactless proximity.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OPTICAL\_CODE:**  
Optical coded reading capabilities (e.g. barcode, QR code, etc.).  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OTHER\_NATIONAL:**  
Other national capability type assigned at national level.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_RFID\_TAG:**  
Radio Frequency Identification tag capabilities.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_UNSPECIFIED:**  
Unspecified capability.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OTHER\_PRIVATE:**  
Other card reading capability assigned on a private basis.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_KEY\_ENTERED:**  
Key entered.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_CARD\_ON\_FILE:**  
Card information is stored on file.

**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.

**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**

**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

### [](#allowedendpoint "Copy link to heading")AllowedEndpoint

#### [](#available_methods_48 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Get](#_services_authentication_roles_GetAllowedEndpointsResponse_GetAllowedEndpoints) GetAllowedEndpoints returns a subset of the endpoints given in the request for which the current user’s privileges allow access.
    

#### [](#_services_authentication_roles_GetAllowedEndpointsResponse_GetAllowedEndpoints "Copy link to heading")Get

GetAllowedEndpoints returns a subset of the endpoints given in the request for which the current user’s privileges allow access.

chat\_bubble

Get AllowedEndpoints only checks endpoint-level scope access, and does not take into consideration resource-level ABAC privileges.

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/allowed-endpoints

## [](#routing "Copy link to heading")Routing

### [](#accountlink "Copy link to heading")AccountLink

#### [](#available_methods_50 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_accounts_ListAccountLinksResponse_ListAccountLinks) Lists and filters AccountLinks.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_accounts_AccountLink_CreateAccountLink) Creates an AccountLink.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_accounts_AccountLink_UpdateAccountLink) Updates an AccountLink.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_accounts_AccountLink_GetAccountLink) Retrieves a single AccountLink by ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_accounts_BatchGetAccountLinksResponse_BatchGetAccountLinks) Retrieves one or more AccountLinks by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_accounts_ListAccountLinksResponse_ListAccountLinks "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters AccountLinks. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.account\_links:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/account-links

##### [](#request_163 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**core\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The core\_ids the AccountLinks are to be filtered on.

 |
| 

**core\_account\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The core\_account\_ids the AccountLinks are to be filtered on.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

 |

##### [](#responses_163 "Copy link to heading")Responses

Success Errors

Response fields  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
|

array \[object\]

 |

 |
|

**id**  
  
string

 | 

Unique identifier of the resource within Vault Payments. UUID. Optional on creation; if not set, a UUID will be generated.

 |
| 

account\_links\[\].  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The status of the AccountLink.  
  
**Enum values**  
**ACCOUNT\_LINK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default AccountLink Status value.  
**ACCOUNT\_LINK\_STATUS\_ACTIVE:**  
The AccountLink is Active and can be used during Instruction processing.  
**ACCOUNT\_LINK\_STATUS\_INACTIVE:**  
The AccountLink is Inactive and cannot be used during Instruction processing.

 |
|

string

 | 

The identifier of the Core Banking system which stores the associated account. Required on creation.

 |

string

 |

 |
|

 |

 |

### [](#paymentinstrument "Copy link to heading")PaymentInstrument

#### [](#available_methods_51 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_accounts_ListPaymentInstrumentsResponse_ListPaymentInstruments) Lists PaymentInstruments.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_accounts_PaymentInstrument_CreatePaymentInstrument) Creates a PaymentInstrument.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_accounts_PaymentInstrument_GetPaymentInstrument) Retrieves a single PaymentInstrument by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_accounts_PaymentInstrument_UpdatePaymentInstrument) Updates a PaymentInstrument.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_accounts_BatchGetPaymentInstrumentsResponse_BatchGetPaymentInstruments) Retrieves one or more PaymentInstruments by ID.
    
-   [Search](#_payments_v1_accounts_SearchPaymentInstrumentsResponse_SearchPaymentInstruments) Lists and filters PaymentInstruments.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_accounts_ListPaymentInstrumentsResponse_ListPaymentInstruments "Copy link to heading")List

Lists PaymentInstruments. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.payment\_instruments:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/payment-instruments

##### [](#request_168 "Copy link to heading")Request

| --- | --- |

integer

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

-   [List](#_payments_v1_rules_ListRulesResponse_ListRules) List and filter for Rules.

#### [](#_payments_v1_rules_ListRulesResponse_ListRules "Copy link to heading")List

List and filter for Rules. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp`.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.rules:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/rules

##### [](#request_174 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**rule\_types**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The Rule Types the Rules are to be filtered on.  
  
**Enum values**  
**RULE\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default Rule Type value.  
**RULE\_TYPE\_ACCOUNT\_LINK\_SELECTION:**  
Rule to select Account Links. Can only be added to account\_selection\_rules on PaymentInstruments.  
**RULE\_TYPE\_BASIC:**  
Rule to raise restrictions or update the Instruction resource during Instruction processing. Can be added to rules on PaymentInstruments and RuleSets.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

 |
| 

**fields\_to\_include**  
  
array \[enum\]

 | 

The fields to include when retrieving the list of Rules. Only if present here will the field be included in the response.  
  
**Enum values**  
**INCLUDE\_FIELD\_ACTIVE\_VERSION:**  
Include the active Version for the resource.

object

**type**  
  
enum

 | 

The type of the Rule. Determines how the Rule is evaluated and where it can be applied on PaymentInstrument or RuleSet.  
  
**Enum values**  
**RULE\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN:**  
Default Rule Type value.  
**RULE\_TYPE\_ACCOUNT\_LINK\_SELECTION:**  
Rule to select Account Links. Can only be added to account\_selection\_rules on PaymentInstruments.  
**RULE\_TYPE\_BASIC:**  
Rule to raise restrictions or update the Instruction resource during Instruction processing. Can be added to rules on PaymentInstruments and RuleSets.  
  
**Default**  
**RULE\_TYPE\_UNKNOWN**

#### [](#available_methods_53 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_rules_ListRuleSetsResponse_ListRuleSets) List and filter for RuleSets.

-   [Get](#_payments_v1_rules_RuleSet_GetRuleSet) Retrieve a Rule Set by ID.

#### [](#_payments_v1_rules_ListRuleSetsResponse_ListRuleSets "Copy link to heading")List

List and filter for RuleSets. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp`.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.rule\_sets:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/rule-sets

#### [](#_payments_v1_rules_ListRuleSetVersionsResponse_ListRuleSetVersions "Copy link to heading")List

List and filter for RuleSetVersions. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.rule\_set\_versions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/rule-set-versions

integer

Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

string

#### [](#available_methods_55 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_rules_ListRuleVersionsResponse_ListRuleVersions) List and filter for RuleVersions.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_rules_RuleVersion_CreateRuleVersion) Create a RuleVersion.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_rules_RuleVersion_GetRuleVersion) Retrieve a RuleVersion by ID.

#### [](#_payments_v1_rules_ListRuleVersionsResponse_ListRuleVersions "Copy link to heading")List

List and filter for RuleVersions. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.rule\_versions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/rule-versions

##### [](#request_188 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**rule\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Rule IDs the RuleVersions are to be filtered on.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

 |

**card\_data\_entry\_mode**  
  
enum

 | 

The method of entering the card data.  
  
**Enum values**  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILIIES\_UNKNOWN:**  
The card data reading capabilities are unknown.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_PROXIMITY:**  
The card data was entered using ICC contactless proximity. If this value is set on `card_data_entry_mode`, `psn` must also be set.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MAGNETIC\_STRIPE:**  
The card data was entered using magnetic stripe.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_CONTACT:**  
The card data was entered using ICC contact. If this value is set on `card_data_entry_mode`, `psn` must also be set.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OTHER\_PRIVATE:**  
The card data was entered through some other method. If this value is set on `card_data_entry_mode`, `other_card_data_entry_mode` must also be set.  
  
**Default**  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILIIES\_UNKNOWN**

**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_MAGNETIC\_STRIPE:**  
The card data was entered using magnetic stripe.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_ICC\_CONTACT:**  
The card data was entered using ICC contact. If this value is set on `card_data_entry_mode`, `psn` must also be set.  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILITIES\_OTHER\_PRIVATE:**  
The card data was entered through some other method. If this value is set on `card_data_entry_mode`, `other_card_data_entry_mode` must also be set.  
  
**Default**  
**CARD\_DATA\_READING\_CAPABILIIES\_UNKNOWN**

## [](#simulator_credit_transfers "Copy link to heading")Simulator Credit Transfers

### [](#inboundcredittransfer "Copy link to heading")InboundCreditTransfer

#### [](#available_methods_62 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Simulate](#_payments_v1_credit_transfer_simulator_SimulateInboundCreditTransferResponse_SimulateInboundCreditTransfer) SimulateInboundCreditTransfer can be used to simulate an inbound instant payment to a payment instrument that is recognised by Vault Payments.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_credit_transfer_simulator_SimulateInboundCreditTransferResponse_SimulateInboundCreditTransfer "Copy link to heading")Simulate

SimulateInboundCreditTransfer can be used to simulate an inbound instant payment to a payment instrument that is recognised by Vault Payments. The simulator uses parameters specified in the request to create an inbound FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer (pacs 008) [Instruction](/vault-payments/latest/EN/api/payments_api#Instructions). An inbound FIToFIPaymentStatusReport (pacs 002) Instruction is also generated. The transaction\_status of the FIToFIPaymentStatusReport matches the result of the FIToFICustomerCreditTransfer.

**Endpoint:** POST /api/sandbox/simulate/credit-transfers/inbound

##### [](#request_198 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique ID for the request. Used for idempotence. Maps to the following fields within the created Instruction `fi_to_fi_customer_credit_transfer.message_v08.credit_transfer_transaction_information[0].payment_identification.`: `instruction_identification`, `clearing_system_reference` Required.

 |
| 

**reference**  
  
string

 | 

A reference that can be used to identify the simulated payment. Maps to `fi_to_fi_customer_credit_transfer.message_v08.credit_transfer_transaction_information[0].end_to_end_identification` on the Instruction. Required.

 |
| 

**amount**  
  
string

 | 

Amount of money moved between the simulated instructing agent and the instructed agent. Maps to following fields within the created Instruction `fi_to_fi_customer_credit_transfer.message_v08.credit_transfer_transaction_information[0]`: `interbank_settlement_amount.amount`, `instructed_amount.amount`. Required.

 |
| 

**currency**  
  
string

 | 

Unit of currency. Maps to following fields within the created Instruction `fi_to_fi_customer_credit_transfer.message_v08.credit_transfer_transaction_information[0]`: `interbank_settlement_amount.currency`, `instructed_amount.currency`. Required.

 |
| 

**creditor**  
  
object

 | 

The identification details associated with creditor account. For successful requests a Payment Instrument should exist for the IBAN or generic identification specified. Maps to `fi_to_fi_customer_credit_transfer.message_v08.credit_transfer_transaction_information[0].creditor_account` and `fi_to_fi_customer_credit_transfer.message_v08.credit_transfer_transaction_information[0].creditor` on the Instruction. Required.

 |
| 

creditor.  
**name**  
  
string

 | 

Name by which a person is known and which is usually used to identify that person.

 |
| 

creditor.  
**iban**  
  
string

 | 

The IBAN associated with the account.  
  
*creditor can contain one of **iban** or other*

 |
| 

creditor.

object

 | 

The generic identification associated with the account.  
  
*creditor can contain one of iban or **other***

 |

### [](#inboundcredittransferreturn "Copy link to heading")InboundCreditTransferReturn

#### [](#available_methods_63 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Simulate](#_payments_v1_credit_transfer_simulator_SimulateInboundCreditTransferReturnResponse_SimulateInboundCreditTransferReturn) SimulateInboundCreditTransfer can be used to simulate the receiving of a return instruction for an outbound instant payment that was successfully completed by Vault Payments.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_credit_transfer_simulator_SimulateInboundCreditTransferReturnResponse_SimulateInboundCreditTransferReturn "Copy link to heading")Simulate

SimulateInboundCreditTransfer can be used to simulate the receiving of a return instruction for an outbound instant payment that was successfully completed by Vault Payments. The simulator uses parameters specified in the request to create an inbound PaymentReturn (pacs 004) [Instruction](/vault-payments/latest/EN/api/payments_api#Instructions).

**Endpoint:** POST /api/sandbox/simulate/credit-transfers/inbound-return

##### [](#request_199 "Copy link to heading")Request

Body parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**request\_id**  
  
string

 | 

A unique ID for the request. Used for idempotence. Required.

 |
| 

**to\_return\_instruction\_id**  
  
string

 | 

The ID of the Instruction that is to be returned. The Instruction must satisfy the following: `scheme`must be "TMInstant", `type` must be "INSTRUCTION\_TYPE\_FI\_TO\_FI\_CUSTOMER\_CREDIT\_TRANSFER", `direction` must be "INSTRUCTION\_DIRECTION\_OUTBOUND" and the `outcome` must be "OUTCOME\_ACCEPTED". Required.

 |
| 

**reason**  
  
string

 | 

The reason for the return. Maps to `payment_return.message_v09.transaction_information[0].return_reason_information.reason.code` on the PaymentReturn (pacs 004) Instruction. Required.

 |
| 

**amount**  
  
string

 | 

The amount of money that is to be returned. Maps to `payment_return.message_v09.transaction_information[0].returned_interbank_settlement_amount.amount` on the PaymentReturn Instruction. Required.

 |
| 

**currency**  
  
string

 | 

Unit of currency. Maps to `payment_return.message_v09.transaction_information[0].returned_interbank_settlement_amount.currency` on the PaymentReturn Instruction. Required.

 |

## [](#simulator_swift_agi "Copy link to heading")Simulator SWIFT AGI

### [](#receivedinstantmessage "Copy link to heading")ReceivedInstantMessage

#### [](#available_methods_64 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [Simulate](#_google_protobuf_Empty_SimulateReceivedInstantMessage) SimulateReceivedInstantMessage enqueues an instant message, also known as a ReceiveIndication, on the SWIFT AGI Simulator, to be processed by Vault Payments.
    

#### [](#_google_protobuf_Empty_SimulateReceivedInstantMessage "Copy link to heading")Simulate

SimulateReceivedInstantMessage enqueues an instant message, also known as a ReceiveIndication, on the SWIFT AGI Simulator, to be processed by Vault Payments. The endpoint will wait for Vault Payments to pick up the ReceiveIndication before returning. If this does not happen before the request timeout, an error will be returned. Note that request can be supplied in either snake or camel case.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.sandbox:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/sandbox/simulate/swift-agi

**REASON\_CODE\_SET\_EXTERNAL\_INVESTIGATION\_REASON\_1:**

activity\_log\[\].  
status\_update\_details.  
**previous\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The previous status of the Task.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

 |

| 

activity\_log\[\].  
system\_transition\_details.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_tasks_Task_ReviewTask "Copy link to heading")Review

Reviews a Task by ID.

A Task can only be reviewed if it is in status AWAITING\_APPROVAL, and only affects the lifecycle of a Task if the roles of the caller are one of the roles in the current approval stage. Once all the criteria in an approval stage are met, then the Task will proceed to the next approval stage. Once all criteria in all approval stages are met, the Task will proceed to the EXECUTING status.

This can only be called using a user token.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.tasks:write

**Endpoint:** POST /api/v1/tasks/{review.task\_id}:review

enum

 |

**Enum values**  
**TASK\_REVIEW\_OUTCOME\_UNKNOWN:**  
The outcome of the review is unknown.  
**TASK\_REVIEW\_OUTCOME\_APPROVED:**  
The reviewer has decided to approve.  
**TASK\_REVIEW\_OUTCOME\_REJECTED:**  
The reviewer has decided to reject.  
**TASK\_REVIEW\_OUTCOME\_CLAIMED:**  
The reviewer has decided to claim for later review.  
**TASK\_REVIEW\_OUTCOME\_UNCLAIMED:**  
The reviewer has decided to unclaim a prior claim.  
  
**Default**  
**TASK\_REVIEW\_OUTCOME\_UNKNOWN**

activity\_log\[\].  
status\_update\_details.  
**previous\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The previous status of the Task.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

 |
|

 |
| 

activity\_log\[\].  
system\_transition\_details.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_tasks_Task_UpdateTask "Copy link to heading")Update

Updates a Task.

When there is no assignee, any user can update to set their user ID as the assignee to assign themselves. When there is an assignee, only the assignee is permitted to update the field, and can only set the field to empty string to unassign themselves.

Only the current assignee can update the summary, status, or subfields of details. The summary can be updated at any time, but other fields can only be updated if the Task is not in a terminal status. Note that updating the subfields of details will reset the approval state. Furthermore, only the following status transitions are permitted:

-   IN\_PROGRESS to ABANDONED (if type is not MANUAL\_DECISION\_SUBMISSION)
    
-   AWAITING\_APPROVAL to ABANDONED (if type is not MANUAL\_DECISION\_SUBMISSION)
    
-   REJECTED to ABANDONED (if type is not MANUAL\_DECISION\_SUBMISSION)
    
-   IN\_PROGRESS to AWAITING\_APPROVAL (see below)
    

When a Task’s status is updated to AWAITING\_APPROVAL, a system transition may occur automatically:

-   AWAITING\_APPROVAL to REJECTED (if a prior relevant review was recorded as rejected)
    
-   AWAITING\_APPROVAL to EXECUTING (if no approval\_stages are configured)
    

This can only be called using a user token.

Fields allowed for update are summary, assignee, status, details.vault\_payments.parameter\_value\_change.proposed\_value, and details.vault\_payments.manual\_decision\_submission.proposed\_decision.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.tasks:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/tasks/{task.id}

 |

task.  
**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The current status of the Task.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.  
  
**Default**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN**

**status**  
  
enum

 | 

The current status of the Task.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

activity\_log\[\].  
status\_update\_details.  
**previous\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The previous status of the Task.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

 |

 |
| 

activity\_log\[\].  
system\_transition\_details.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

enum

**Enum values**  
**UNKNOWN:**

**INVALID\_FORMAT:**

**INVALID\_VALUE:**  
Indicates that a provided field is not equal to one of the specified values.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**  
Field exceeds a maximum specified value.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**  
Field is smaller than a minimum specified value.  
**ABOVE\_MAX\_LENGTH:**  
Length is larger than a maximum specified size.  
**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**  
Length is smaller than a minimum specified size.  
**PATTERN\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified regex pattern.  
**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

string

 |

#### [](#_payments_v1_tasks_Task_ManageTask "Copy link to heading")Manage

Manages a Task by ID, allowing updates to certain fields not permitted by the ordinary Update endpoint.

If the approval\_stages are updated, the approval state of the Task will be reset.

This can only be called using a user token.

Fields allowed for update are assignee, assignee\_profile, and approval\_stages.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.tasks:manage

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/tasks/{task.id}:manage

##### [](#request_205 "Copy link to heading")Request

**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

activity\_log\[\].  
status\_update\_details.  
**previous\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The previous status of the Task.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

 |
|

activity\_log\[\].  
system\_transition\_details.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

#### [](#_payments_v1_tasks_BatchGetTasksResponse_BatchGetTasks "Copy link to heading")BatchGet

Retrieves one or more Tasks by ID.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.tasks:read

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/tasks:batchGet

##### [](#request_206 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

List of IDs of Tasks to retrieve.  
This field must contain a valid UUID in the canonical 8-4-4-4-12 form.  
Required.  
Min length: 1 characters.  
Max length: 100 characters.

enum

 | 

The current status of the Task.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

tasks\[KEY\].  
activity\_log\[\].  
status\_update\_details.  
**previous\_status**  
  
enum

 | 

The previous status of the Task.  
  
**Enum values**  
**TASK\_STATUS\_UNKNOWN:**  
The status of the Task is unknown.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_QUEUED:**  
The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

 |
|

The Task is not currently assigned, but is available for ownership.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_IN\_PROGRESS:**  
The Task is currently assigned to an operator, and is thus considered to be in progress.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_AWAITING\_APPROVAL:**  
The Task has been submitted for review by its owner and is awaiting approval.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_REJECTED:**  
The Task has been rejected by a reviewer.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_EXECUTING:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track is in the process of being executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_COMPLETED:**  
The action the Task was instantiated to track has been successfully executed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ERRORED:**  
The Task is in a terminally errored state.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The deadline to address the Task has passed.  
**TASK\_STATUS\_ABANDONED:**  
The Task has been abandoned.

tasks\[KEY\].  
activity\_log\[\].  
system\_transition\_details.  
error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

## [](#templates "Copy link to heading")Templates

### [](#template "Copy link to heading")Template

#### [](#available_methods_67 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_templates_ListTemplatesResponse_ListTemplates) List and filter for Templates.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_templates_Template_CreateTemplate) Creates a Template.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_templates_Template_UpdateTemplate) Updates a Template.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_templates_Template_GetTemplate) Retrieves a Template by ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_templates_BatchGetTemplatesResponse_BatchGetTemplates) Retrieves one or more Templates by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_templates_ListTemplatesResponse_ListTemplates "Copy link to heading")List

List and filter for Templates. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp`.

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.app.templates:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/app/templates

##### [](#request_207 "Copy link to heading")Request

#### [](#_payments_v1_templates_Template_UpdateTemplate "Copy link to heading")Update

**Permission Scopes:** payments:write, payments.app.templates:write

**Endpoint:** PUT /api/v1/app/templates

### [](#templateversion "Copy link to heading")TemplateVersion

#### [](#available_methods_68 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_templates_ListTemplateVersionsResponse_ListTemplateVersions) List and filter for TemplateVersions.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_templates_TemplateVersion_CreateTemplateVersion) Creates a TemplateVersion.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_templates_TemplateVersion_GetTemplateVersion) Retrieves a TemplateVersion by ID.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_templates_BatchGetTemplateVersionsResponse_BatchGetTemplateVersions) Retrieves one or more TemplateVersions by ID.
    
-   [Validate](#_payments_v1_templates_ValidateTemplateVersionResponse_ValidateTemplateVersion) Validates a TemplateVersion.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_templates_ListTemplateVersionsResponse_ListTemplateVersions "Copy link to heading")List

List and filter for TemplateVersions. Results are returned ordered by descending `create_timestamp` (most recently created first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.app.template\_versions:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Snapshot

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/app/template-versions

##### [](#request_212 "Copy link to heading")Request

Query parameters  
| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 
**template\_ids**  
  
array \[string\]

 | 

The Template IDs the TemplateVersions are to be filtered on. Optional.  
  
Max length: 100 characters.

 |
| 

**page\_size**  
  
integer

 | 

The maximum number of results to be returned.  
  
Required.  
Min value: 1.  
Max value: 100.

 |
| 

**page\_token**  
  
string

 | 

The token of the page the results are retrieved from. Optional. If empty, the first page of results will be returned.

 |

**ABOVE\_MAX\_VALUE:**

**BELOW\_MIN\_VALUE:**

**BELOW\_MIN\_LENGTH:**

**PREFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified prefix.  
**SUFFIX\_MISMATCH:**  
Field value does not match the specified suffix.  
**REQUIRED\_FIELD:**  
Field value was not populated but is required to be.  
**DUPLICATE\_VALUE:**  
All elements in this field must be unique but a duplicate value has been provided. Applies to repeated scalar fields.

error.  
**message**  
  
string

 | 

A human-readable description of the error. The exact message is subject to change and should not be used programmatically.

 |
| 

error.  
**code**  
  
enum

 | 

The code of the error.  
  
**Enum values**  
**OK:**  
Indicates there was no error. In practice, this does not occur as success is communicated by the absence of an error rather than an error with this code.  
**CANCELLED:**  
The requested operation was cancelled part way through.  
**UNKNOWN:**  
An unknown problem occurred on the server.  
**INVALID\_ARGUMENT:**  
There was a problem with the request. A provided field is invalid and/or a required field is missing. Unlike FAILED\_PRECONDITION, the only remedy is likely to be a change to the request.  
**DEADLINE\_EXCEEDED:**  
The response was not received within the allowed time. It can be safely retried. The operation could have completed successfully.  
**NOT\_FOUND:**  
The requested resource could not be found.  
**ALREADY\_EXISTS:**  
The resource could not be created because it already exists.  
**PERMISSION\_DENIED:**  
The client did not have permission to perform the request.  
**UNAUTHENTICATED:**  
The request could not be authenticated.  
**RESOURCE\_EXHAUSTED:**  
A resource was exhausted, because either too many requests were sent within a time period or the response was too large.  
**FAILED\_PRECONDITION:**  
The operation was rejected because the system was not in a state required for the operation’s execution. It could be that a referenced resource did not exist, or was in the wrong state.  
**ABORTED:**  
The operation was aborted, typically due to a concurrency issue.  
**OUT\_OF\_RANGE:**  
The operation was attempted outside the valid range.  
**UNIMPLEMENTED:**  
The operation is not implemented.  
**INTERNAL:**  
A problem occurred on the server. This is almost certainly due to a fault in the platform.  
**UNAVAILABLE:**  
The service was unavailable. It can be safely retried.  
**DATA\_LOSS:**  
The operation resulted in unrecoverable data loss or corruption.

 |
| 

error.  
**details\[\]**  
  
array \[object\]

 | 

An optional list of messages that carry the error details.

 |

### [](#scheduledpayment "Copy link to heading")ScheduledPayment

#### [](#available_methods_70 "Copy link to heading")Available methods

-   [List](#_payments_v1_scheduledpayments_ListScheduledPaymentsResponse_ListScheduledPayments) Lists and filters ScheduledPayments.
    
-   [Create](#_payments_v1_scheduledpayments_ScheduledPayment_CreateScheduledPayment) Creates a ScheduledPayment.
    
-   [Get](#_payments_v1_scheduledpayments_ScheduledPayment_GetScheduledPayment) Retrieves a ScheduledPayment by ID.
    
-   [Update](#_payments_v1_scheduledpayments_ScheduledPayment_UpdateScheduledPayment) Updates a ScheduledPayment.
    
-   [BatchGet](#_payments_v1_scheduledpayments_BatchGetScheduledPaymentsResponse_BatchGetScheduledPayments) Retrieves one or more ScheduledPayments by ID.
    

#### [](#_payments_v1_scheduledpayments_ListScheduledPaymentsResponse_ListScheduledPayments "Copy link to heading")List

Lists and filters ScheduledPayments. Results are returned ordered by descending `update_timestamp` (most recently updated first).

**Permission Scopes:** payments:read, payments.scheduled\_payments:read

**Pagination consistency guarantees:** Page Level

**Endpoint:** GET /api/v1/scheduled-payments
